CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_regulatory_dossier_detail(p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_d public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers; v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_regulatory_can_read() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_d FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
   WHERE microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
   ORDER BY (status='VALIDATED') DESC, version DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF v_d.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'dossier', to_jsonb(v_d),
    'presentations', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.volume_ml)
       FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p WHERE p.dossier_id=v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'ncm_candidates', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.created_at)
       FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c WHERE c.dossier_id=v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'documents', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.uploaded_at)
       FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x WHERE x.dossier_id=v_d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb),
    'checklist', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.item_key)
       FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist k WHERE k.dossier_id=v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'history', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'action',a.action,'changed_at',a.changed_at,'changed_by',a.changed_by,'table_name',a.table_name)
         ORDER BY a.changed_at DESC)
       FROM public.fiscal_audit_log a
       WHERE a.table_name LIKE 'microorganism_%' AND a.record_id = v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'snapshots', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'version',s.version,'published_at',s.published_at,'snapshot_sha256',s.snapshot_sha256)
         ORDER BY s.version DESC)
       FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_publication_snapshots s WHERE s.dossier_id=v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'gate', (SELECT r.gate FROM public.v_microorganism_fiscal_readiness r
              WHERE r.microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END $function$
functions.name: rpc_regulatory_dossier_detail

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_jwt jsonb:=auth.jwt();
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'iat') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'iat','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'exp') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'exp','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
  END IF;
  IF (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint <= 0 OR (v_jwt->>'exp')::bigint <= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
    OR (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint > EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
    OR NOT COALESCE(public.has_role(v_actor,'superadmin'::public.app_role),false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(public.is_platform_superadmin(v_actor),false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_actor),false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_actor;
END;
$function$
functions.name: catalog_metadata_require_actor

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_microorganisms_core(p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_only_active boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_search text; v_items jsonb; v_count int;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
    OR p_only_active IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(COALESCE(p_search,'')) > 120 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_micro_invalid';
  END IF;
  v_search:=pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_search,''));
  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'codigo',m.codigo,'nome',m.nome,'ativo',m.ativo)
    ORDER BY m.nome, m.id),'[]'::jsonb), count(*)
  INTO v_items, v_count FROM (
    SELECT id,codigo,nome,ativo FROM public.microrganismos
    WHERE (NOT p_only_active OR ativo IS TRUE)
      AND (v_search='' OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(nome),pg_catalog.lower(v_search))>0
        OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(COALESCE(codigo,'')),pg_catalog.lower(v_search))>0)
    ORDER BY nome, id LIMIT p_limit+1 OFFSET p_offset) m;
  -- has_more por sentinela (limit+1), itens cortados ao limite.
  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('items',
    CASE WHEN v_count>p_limit THEN v_items - p_limit ELSE v_items END,'has_more',v_count>p_limit);
END;
$function$
functions.name: read_global_microorganisms_core

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cq_resultado_imutavel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Sem excecao por GUC: autoria e imutabilidade valem em todas as chamadas.
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF OLD.resultado IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_RESULTADO_FINAL_IMUTAVEL: análise % do lote % já possui resultado final (%) e não pode ser excluída. Registre uma nova análise (reanálise) para o mesmo lote.',
        OLD.id, OLD.lote_id, OLD.resultado USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  -- transição inicial (pendente -> resultado final) continua permitida
  IF OLD.resultado IS NULL THEN
    IF NEW.lote_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lote_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_LOTE_IMUTAVEL: não é permitido mover a análise de CQ para outro lote.'
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.resultado      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resultado
     OR NEW.lote_id        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lote_id
     OR NEW.responsavel_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.responsavel_id
     OR NEW.responsavel    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.responsavel
     OR NEW.data_analise   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.data_analise
     OR NEW.created_at     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
     OR NEW.seq            IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seq
     OR NEW.ph             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ph
     OR NEW.aparencia      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.aparencia
     OR NEW.odor           IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.odor
     OR NEW.concentracao   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.concentracao
     OR NEW.contaminacao   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contaminacao
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_RESULTADO_FINAL_IMUTAVEL: a análise % do lote % já foi finalizada (%). Registre uma NOVA análise (reanálise) para o mesmo lote em vez de sobrescrever o histórico.',
      OLD.id, OLD.lote_id, OLD.resultado USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: fn_cq_resultado_imutavel

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_entrega_build_snapshot_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'termo-entrega-v1',
    'gerado_em', now(),
    'entrega', to_jsonb(e),
    'cliente', (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id),
    'ordem_servico', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id),
    'ordem_servico_onfarm', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id),
    'pedido_b2b', (SELECT to_jsonb(po) FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id),
    'comprovante', (SELECT to_jsonb(cp) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes cp WHERE cp.id = e.comprovante_id),
    'entregador', jsonb_build_object(
      'motorista', e.motorista, 'documento', e.motorista_documento,
      'telefone', e.motorista_telefone, 'veiculo', e.veiculo,
      'placa', e.veiculo_placa, 'tipo', e.veiculo_tipo),
    'destino', jsonb_build_object(
      'destinatario', e.destinatario_nome, 'telefone', e.destinatario_telefone,
      'logradouro', e.endereco_logradouro, 'numero', e.endereco_numero,
      'complemento', e.endereco_complemento, 'bairro', e.endereco_bairro,
      'cidade', e.endereco_cidade, 'uf', e.endereco_uf, 'cep', e.endereco_cep,
      'referencia', e.endereco_referencia, 'origem', e.endereco_origem),
    'recebedor', jsonb_build_object(
      'nome', e.recebedor_nome, 'documento', e.recebedor_documento,
      'cargo', e.recebedor_cargo, 'telefone', e.recebedor_telefone),
    'itens', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'etiqueta', to_jsonb(pe),
        'embalagem', (SELECT to_jsonb(eb) FROM public.estoque_embalagens eb WHERE eb.id = pe.embalagem_id),
        'lote', (SELECT to_jsonb(l) FROM public.lotes l WHERE l.id = pe.lote_id),
        'produto', (SELECT to_jsonb(pr) FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = pe.produto_id),
        'conferencia', (SELECT to_jsonb(ci) FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
                        WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.etiqueta_id = pe.id)
      )) ORDER BY pe.id)
      FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
      JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
      WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'checklist', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ck) ORDER BY ck.id)
                           FROM public.entrega_checklist ck WHERE ck.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ocorrencias', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(oc) ORDER BY oc.id)
                             FROM public.entrega_ocorrencias oc WHERE oc.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'divergencias', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('etiqueta_id', ci.etiqueta_id, 'status', ci.status,
                                          'quantidade', ci.quantidade, 'motivo', ci.motivo) ORDER BY ci.id)
      FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
      WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.status <> 'aceito'), '[]'::jsonb)
  ))
  INTO v
  FROM public.entregas e
  WHERE e.id = p_entrega_id;

  IF v IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entrega_nao_encontrada' USING ERRCODE = 'raise_exception';
  END IF;
  RETURN v;
END $function$
functions.name: fn_entrega_build_snapshot_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6c_entrega_ar_b2b_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_po public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_settings record;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.partner_order_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.receivable_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = NEW.partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- 1) o recebível passa a pertencer ao parceiro (entra em saldo_em_aberto)
  UPDATE public.accounts_receivable
     SET partner_id = v_po.partner_id
   WHERE id = NEW.receivable_id AND partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po.partner_id;

  -- 2) vínculo financeiro canônico (idempotente: unique em partner_order_id)
  SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = v_po.partner_id;
  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_financial_links(
    partner_order_id, partner_id, receivable_id, financial_status, billing_trigger, created_by)
  VALUES (v_po.id, v_po.partner_id, NEW.receivable_id, 'gerado',
          COALESCE(v_settings.billing_trigger, 'entrega'), NEW.billing_generated_by)
  ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 3) pedido deixa de ser "comprometido não faturado"
  UPDATE public.partner_orders
     SET financial_status = 'gerado',
         receivable_generated = true,
         receivable_generated_at = COALESCE(receivable_generated_at, now()),
         receivable_generated_by = COALESCE(receivable_generated_by, NEW.billing_generated_by)
   WHERE id = v_po.id AND COALESCE(receivable_generated,false) = false;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
functions.name: fn_h6c_entrega_ar_b2b_link

 RETURNS jsonb

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''

declare
  v jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
     and not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'permission_denied' using errcode = '42501';

       where not exists (select 1 from public.partner_accounts pa where pa.id = po.partner_id)),
    'planejamento_sem_pedido',

       where not exists (select 1 from public.partner_orders po where po.id = pp.partner_order_id)),
    'os_sem_planejamento',
      (select count(*) from public.ordens_servico os
       where os.origem = 'b2b' and os.partner_order_id is not null
         and not exists (select 1 from public.production_order_link pol where pol.ordem_servico_id = os.id)),
    'timeline_orfa',

       where not exists (select 1 from public.partner_orders po where po.id = ev.partner_order_id)),
    'os_orfa_b2b',
      (select count(*) from public.ordens_servico os
       where os.origem = 'b2b' and (os.partner_order_id is null or os.partner_order_item_id is null)),
    'itens_sem_produto',
      (select count(*) from public.partner_order_items poi
       where not exists (select 1 from public.produtos p where p.id = poi.product_id)),
    'links_invalidos',

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 p public.programacao_producao%ROWTYPE;
 old_manual boolean:=false;
 old_programacao uuid;
 org uuid;
BEGIN
 -- Lock old/new parents in deterministic order. An UPDATE cannot escape the
 -- manual fence by changing programacao_id to onfarm or NULL.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN old_programacao:=OLD.programacao_id; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
 WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id OR id=old_programacao
 ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
    WHERE id=OLD.programacao_id AND ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL) INTO old_manual;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id;
 IF old_manual OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND old_manual THEN
   org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
   IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND org IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
    AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'producao')) IS TRUE
    AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id=org AND NEW.organization_id=org AND OLD.organization_id=org
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status'-'updated_at') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status'-'updated_at')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org AND o.status::text='em_cq'
     AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
    AND ((OLD.status::text='em_producao' AND NEW.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_send_v1' AND target=NEW.id))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado','reprovado') AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_'||NEW.status::text||'_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.controle_qualidade c WHERE c.lote_id=NEW.id AND c.organization_id=org AND c.resultado::text=NEW.status::text
      AND c.responsavel='DADOS FICTICIOS SEM VALOR COMERCIAL' AND c.ph IS NOT NULL AND c.concentracao IS NOT NULL)))
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- No JWT/GUC/current_user/service-role escape: only the reviewed insert RPC
  -- can issue this private, target-specific ticket; it removes it after INSERT.
  org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR org IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS NULL
   OR public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   OR p.id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org
   OR p.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.produto_id OR p.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id
   OR p.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'aguardando' OR NEW.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'em_producao'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org
     AND o.status::text='programada' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL
     AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_cliente_principal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user uuid;
  v_users uuid[] := '{}';
  v_principal uuid;
  v_marked uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Reconcilia TODOS os usuários afetados: NEW e OLD (UPDATE de user_id
  -- reconcilia o usuário antigo e o novo; nenhum dado é reatribuído).
  -- Coleta por evento: cada trigger statement só executa o branch cuja
  -- transition table existe (plpgsql planeja cada statement na 1ª execução).
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    FOR v_user IN SELECT DISTINCT n.user_id FROM new_rows n LOOP
      v_users := v_users || v_user;
    END LOOP;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    FOR v_user IN SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id FROM old_rows o LOOP
      v_users := v_users || v_user;
    END LOOP;
  ELSE
    FOR v_user IN
      SELECT n.user_id FROM new_rows n
      UNION
      SELECT o.user_id FROM old_rows o
    LOOP
      v_users := v_users || v_user;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  FOREACH v_user IN ARRAY v_users LOOP
    -- 1) Rebaixa principais não vigentes (inativo, revogado, futuro, expirado).
    --    Só emite UPDATE quando há trabalho: é o que encerra a recursão.
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes
       WHERE user_id = v_user AND principal = true
         AND NOT (is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
                  AND valid_from <= now()
                  AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now()))
    ) THEN
      UPDATE public.user_clientes
         SET principal = false
       WHERE user_id = v_user
         AND principal = true
         AND NOT (is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
                  AND valid_from <= now()
                  AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now()));
    END IF;

    -- 2) Principal explicitamente marcado e vigente neste comando vence;
    --    desempate determinístico (created_at, id) se houver mais de um
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
      v_marked := NULL;
    ELSE
      SELECT uc.id INTO v_marked
        FROM new_rows n
        JOIN public.user_clientes uc ON uc.id = n.id
       WHERE n.user_id = v_user AND n.principal
         AND uc.is_active AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
         AND uc.valid_from <= now()
         AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
       ORDER BY uc.created_at ASC, uc.id ASC
       LIMIT 1;
    END IF;
    IF v_marked IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes
                    WHERE user_id = v_user AND id <> v_marked AND principal = true) THEN
      UPDATE public.user_clientes
         SET principal = false
       WHERE user_id = v_user
         AND id <> v_marked
         AND principal = true;
    END IF;

    -- 3) Garante exatamente um principal vigente (mais antigo; desempate por id)
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes
       WHERE user_id = v_user AND principal = true
         AND is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
         AND valid_from <= now()
         AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now())
    ) AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes
       WHERE user_id = v_user
         AND is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
         AND valid_from <= now()
         AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now())
    ) THEN
      UPDATE public.user_clientes
         SET principal = true
       WHERE id = (
         SELECT id FROM public.user_clientes
          WHERE user_id = v_user
            AND is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
            AND valid_from <= now()
            AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now())
          ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
          LIMIT 1
       );
    END IF;

    -- 4) profiles.cliente_id SOMENTE com principal vigente (ou NULL);
    --    nunca aponta para vínculo histórico/revogado
    SELECT cliente_id INTO v_principal
      FROM public.user_clientes
     WHERE user_id = v_user AND principal = true
       AND is_active AND revoked_at IS NULL
       AND valid_from <= now()
       AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= now())
     LIMIT 1;

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
                WHERE user_id = v_user AND cliente_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_principal) THEN
      UPDATE public.profiles
         SET cliente_id = v_principal
       WHERE user_id = v_user
         AND cliente_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_principal;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
functions.name: sync_user_cliente_principal

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_fiscal_cfs_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid;
  v_new   jsonb;
  v_old   jsonb;
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    v_actor := auth.uid();
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    v_actor := NULL;
  END;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    v_new := jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                     NEW.id,
      'configuration_status',   NEW.configuration_status,
      'fiscal_environment',     NEW.fiscal_environment,
      'nfe_provider',           NEW.nfe_provider,
      'nfse_provider',          NEW.nfse_provider,
      'nfe_enabled',            NEW.nfe_enabled,
      'nfse_enabled',           NEW.nfse_enabled,
      'production_enabled',     NEW.production_enabled,
      'configuration_version',  NEW.configuration_version,
      'last_validation_status', NEW.last_validation_status,
      'nfe_config_field_count',  public.jsonb_object_keys_count(NEW.nfe_configuration),
      'nfse_config_field_count', public.jsonb_object_keys_count(NEW.nfse_configuration),
      'has_nfe_credential_ref',  (NEW.nfe_credential_ref  IS NOT NULL),
      'has_nfse_credential_ref', (NEW.nfse_credential_ref IS NOT NULL),
      'has_certificate_ref',     (NEW.certificate_ref     IS NOT NULL),
      'has_webhook_ref',         (NEW.webhook_ref         IS NOT NULL),
      'has_configuration_notes', (NEW.configuration_notes IS NOT NULL)
    );
    INSERT INTO public.fiscal_audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, changed_by, new_values)
    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id, 'INSERT', v_actor, v_new);
    RETURN NEW;

  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    v_old := jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                     OLD.id,
      'configuration_status',   OLD.configuration_status,
      'fiscal_environment',     OLD.fiscal_environment,
      'nfe_provider',           OLD.nfe_provider,
      'nfse_provider',          OLD.nfse_provider,
      'nfe_enabled',            OLD.nfe_enabled,
      'nfse_enabled',           OLD.nfse_enabled,
      'production_enabled',     OLD.production_enabled,
      'configuration_version',  OLD.configuration_version,
      'last_validation_status', OLD.last_validation_status,
      'nfe_config_field_count',  public.jsonb_object_keys_count(OLD.nfe_configuration),
      'nfse_config_field_count', public.jsonb_object_keys_count(OLD.nfse_configuration),
      'has_nfe_credential_ref',  (OLD.nfe_credential_ref  IS NOT NULL),
      'has_nfse_credential_ref', (OLD.nfse_credential_ref IS NOT NULL),
      'has_certificate_ref',     (OLD.certificate_ref     IS NOT NULL),
      'has_webhook_ref',         (OLD.webhook_ref         IS NOT NULL),
      'has_configuration_notes', (OLD.configuration_notes IS NOT NULL)
    );
    v_new := jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                     NEW.id,
      'configuration_status',   NEW.configuration_status,
      'fiscal_environment',     NEW.fiscal_environment,
      'nfe_provider',           NEW.nfe_provider,
      'nfse_provider',          NEW.nfse_provider,
      'nfe_enabled',            NEW.nfe_enabled,
      'nfse_enabled',           NEW.nfse_enabled,
      'production_enabled',     NEW.production_enabled,
      'configuration_version',  NEW.configuration_version,
      'last_validation_status', NEW.last_validation_status,
      'nfe_config_field_count',  public.jsonb_object_keys_count(NEW.nfe_configuration),
      'nfse_config_field_count', public.jsonb_object_keys_count(NEW.nfse_configuration),
      'has_nfe_credential_ref',  (NEW.nfe_credential_ref  IS NOT NULL),
      'has_nfse_credential_ref', (NEW.nfse_credential_ref IS NOT NULL),
      'has_certificate_ref',     (NEW.certificate_ref     IS NOT NULL),
      'has_webhook_ref',         (NEW.webhook_ref         IS NOT NULL),
      'has_configuration_notes', (NEW.configuration_notes IS NOT NULL)
    );
    INSERT INTO public.fiscal_audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, changed_by, old_values, new_values)
    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id, 'UPDATE', v_actor, v_old, v_new);
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- DELETE não é auditado por este trigger (policy nega DELETE nesta tabela).
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_volume_assert_row(p_id uuid, p_tipo text, p_item uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.catalogo_volumes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.catalogo_volumes WHERE id=p_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR r.item_tipo IS DISTINCT FROM p_tipo OR COALESCE(r.produto_id,r.microrganismo_id) IS DISTINCT FROM p_item
    OR r.moeda IS DISTINCT FROM 'BRL'
    OR r.preco_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.preco_brl/(r.volume_ml/1000.0),2)
    OR r.valor_dose_100ml_brl IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.preco_litro_brl/10.0,2)
    OR r.doses_por_volume IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.volume_ml/100.0,4) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
  -- Duplicidade: no máximo uma apresentação ATIVA por pai e volume.
  IF r.ativo AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalogo_volumes o WHERE o.id<>r.id AND o.ativo AND o.volume_ml=r.volume_ml
      AND o.item_tipo=r.item_tipo AND o.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.produto_id AND o.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.microrganismo_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23505', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_duplicate'; END IF;
END;

AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.nfe_readiness_pendencies := public.fn_fiscal_recipient_pendencies_row(NEW);

    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.nfe_readiness_pendencies) e WHERE e->>'severity'='BLOCK') THEN 'NOT_READY'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_item_volumes_core(p_item_tipo text, p_item_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_parent jsonb; v_items jsonb; v_more boolean;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_invalid'; END IF;
  v_parent:=platform_private.catalog_volume_parent(p_item_tipo,p_item_id,false);
  WITH page AS (
    SELECT v.id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v.ordem, v.volume_ml, v.id) rn FROM public.catalogo_volumes v
     WHERE v.item_tipo=p_item_tipo AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id)=p_item_id
     ORDER BY v.ordem, v.volume_ml, v.id LIMIT p_limit+1 OFFSET p_offset)
  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(platform_private.catalog_volume_row(id) ORDER BY rn) FILTER (WHERE rn<=p_offset+p_limit),'[]'::jsonb),
         count(*)>p_limit
    INTO v_items, v_more FROM page;
  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('item',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('tipo',p_item_tipo,'id',p_item_id,'nome',v_parent->'nome',
      'codigo',v_parent->'codigo','ativo',v_parent->'ativo','pricing',platform_private.catalog_volume_pricing(v_parent) - 'updated_at'),
    'items',v_items,'has_more',v_more);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_registro_status_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_allowed BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_user_role public.app_role;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    -- Obter a role do usuário atual
    SELECT role INTO v_user_role FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;

    -- Matriz de transições permitidas
    v_allowed := CASE
      -- Fluxo padrão
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'rascunho' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_andamento', 'finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE

      -- H9-E1: visita iniciada por start_technical_visit_secure e encerrada por
      -- finish_technical_visit_secure. Estado intermediario legitimo do fluxo de campo.
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'em_andamento' AND NEW.status::text IN ('finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'finalizado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('enviado_aprovacao', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Durante Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado', 'reprovado', 'rascunho', 'finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Pós Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('convertido_os', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- REABERTURA: Só administrador pode reabrir um aprovado para enviado_aprovacao
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND v_user_role = 'administrador' THEN TRUE
      
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'convertido_os' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'reprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END;

    IF NOT v_allowed THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transição inválida: não é possível mudar de "%" para "%". Conclua a etapa atual antes de avançar ou verifique suas permissões.',
        OLD.status, NEW.status
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;

    -- Validações adicionais ao finalizar (VT)
    IF NEW.status::text = 'finalizado' AND OLD.status::text IN ('rascunho', 'em_andamento') THEN
      IF COALESCE(TRIM(NEW.problema_principal), '') = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Para finalizar a visita, informe o problema principal.'
          USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Log da transição com metadados estendidos
    INSERT INTO public.registros_consultor_status_log (
      registro_consultor_id, 
      status_anterior, 
      status_novo, 
      changed_by
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.id, 
      OLD.status::TEXT, 
      NEW.status::TEXT, 
      auth.uid()
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: validate_registro_status_transition

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH actor AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT auth.uid() AS uid, public.h15_actor_organization() AS org
   WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid())
     AND public.storage1_path_strict(_name)
     AND _name ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/(foto|audio|documento)/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$'
     AND public.storage1_consultor_allowed(_name, 'select')
 ), roles AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT jsonb_agg(ur.role::text ORDER BY ur.role::text) AS value
   FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN actor a ON ur.user_id = a.uid
 ), docs AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT f.id, f.arquivo_path, r.id AS visit, r.cliente_id AS client, a.uid, a.org
   FROM public.registros_consultor_arquivos f
   JOIN public.registros_consultor r ON r.id = f.registro_consultor_id
   JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = r.cliente_id
   JOIN actor a ON a.org = c.organization_id
   WHERE f.arquivo_path = _name
     AND split_part(_name, '/', 1) = a.org::text
     AND split_part(_name, '/', 2) = r.id::text
     AND public.technical_refs_in_actor_tenant(r.cliente_id, r.fazenda_id, r.talhao_id)
     AND public.technical_child_read_scope(r.id)
 )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id uuid, p_catalog_v2 boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, product_id uuid, produto_nome text, produto_codigo text, descricao_curta text, preco_tabela numeric, desconto_percentual numeric, preco_parceiro numeric, produto_ativo boolean, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, unidade_preco_principal text, familia_catalogo text, catalog_contract text, ficha_conteudo jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_catalog_v2 IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_contract_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='microrganismo' THEN 'biologico'::text ELSE p.familia_catalogo END, 'C1B_DUAL_TENANT_V1'::text,
 CASE WHEN r.ficha_aprovada IS TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
  'subtitulo', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.tipo::text ELSE m.nome_cientifico END,
  'funcao', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.funcao_completa ELSE m.funcao_agronomica END,
  'dose_ml_ha', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.dose_ml_ha ELSE m.dose_ml_ha END,
  'explicacao_produtor', COALESCE(pp.explicacao_produtor,mp.explicacao_produtor),
  'indicacoes_uso', COALESCE(pp.indicacoes_uso,mp.indicacoes_uso),
  'cuidados_aplicacao', COALESCE(pp.cuidados_aplicacao,mp.cuidados_aplicacao),
  'mecanismo_acao', mp.mecanismo_acao,
  'alvos_count', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN
    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_target_recommendations t WHERE t.produto_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE)
    ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_targets t WHERE t.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE) END,
  'fontes_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.catalog_technical_sources cs WHERE cs.entidade_id=r.item_id
    AND cs.entidade_tipo IN (r.item_tipo, 'ficha_' || r.item_tipo))
 ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
 FROM public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id) r

 LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND m.id=r.item_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_product_catalog_by_family_core(p_familia text, p_revisao text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_search text; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_revisao IS NULL OR p_revisao NOT IN ('familia','todos','pendentes')
     OR (p_revisao = 'familia' AND (p_familia IS NULL OR p_familia NOT IN ('biologico','quimico','fertilizante_adubo')))
     OR (p_revisao <> 'familia' AND p_familia IS NOT NULL)
     OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 50
     OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 OR p_offset > 1000000
     OR p_search IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(p_search) > 120 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='platform_catalog_invalid_query';
  END IF;
  v_search := pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p_search));
  WITH bounded AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.id, p.codigo, p.nome, p.tipo, COALESCE(p.ativo,false) AS ativo, p.b2b_enabled, p.updated_at,
           p.familia_catalogo, p.classe_catalogo
    FROM public.produtos p
    WHERE ((p_revisao = 'familia' AND p.familia_catalogo IS NOT NULL AND p.familia_catalogo = p_familia)
        OR p_revisao = 'todos'
        OR (p_revisao = 'pendentes' AND p.familia_catalogo IS NULL))
      AND (v_search = ''
       OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(p.nome), v_search) > 0
       OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(COALESCE(p.codigo, '')), v_search) > 0)
    ORDER BY (p.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(p.nome) COLLATE "C", p.id
    LIMIT (p_limit + 1) OFFSET p_offset
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM bounded b ORDER BY (b.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(b.nome) COLLATE "C", b.id LIMIT p_limit
  )
  SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'items', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(r)
      ORDER BY (r.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(r.nome) COLLATE "C", r.id) FROM page r), '[]'::jsonb),
    'has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > p_limit FROM bounded)
  ) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
functions.name: read_global_product_catalog_by_family_core

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_reject_partner_orders_no_items(p_horas integer DEFAULT 72)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count int := 0; v_rec record;
BEGIN
  FOR v_rec IN
    SELECT id, partner_id, numero
      FROM public.partner_orders
     WHERE status = 'aguardando_itens'
       AND itens_pendentes_solicitado_em IS NOT NULL
       AND itens_pendentes_solicitado_em < now() - make_interval(hours => p_horas)
     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.partner_orders
       SET status = 'reprovado_sem_itens',
           approved_at = now(),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_rec.id AND status = 'aguardando_itens';

    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs(order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (v_rec.id, v_rec.partner_id, NULL, 'auto_rejected_no_items',
            jsonb_build_object('status','aguardando_itens'),
            jsonb_build_object('status','reprovado_sem_itens','sla_horas',p_horas));

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_aplicacao(_aplicacao_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    _aplicacao_id IS NOT NULL
    AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.aplicacoes a
      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = a.ordem_servico_id
      LEFT JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = os.cliente_id
      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico_onfarm oso ON oso.id = a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id
      LEFT JOIN public.clientes co ON co.id = oso.cliente_id
      WHERE a.id = _aplicacao_id
        AND a.organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()
        -- Every present parent must exist and remain in the application's tenant.
        AND (a.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR (
          os.id IS NOT NULL AND os.organization_id = a.organization_id
          AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.organization_id = a.organization_id
        ))
        -- On-farm has no organization_id: its persisted client is the tenant origin.
        AND (a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL OR (
          oso.id IS NOT NULL AND co.id IS NOT NULL
          AND co.organization_id = a.organization_id
        ))
        AND (
          public.is_operational_staff(auth.uid())
          OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::app_role)
          OR os.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
          OR oso.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
        )
    ), false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_cliente(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'administrador'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor_comercial'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor'::app_role), false)
  THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;

  -- HARDENING: papéis técnicos exigem carteira ativa e vigente.
  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'tecnico_agronomo'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'consultor_tecnico'::app_role), false)
  THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(
      public.has_active_user_cliente_access(
        _user_id, _cliente_id, ARRAY['read','execute','manage']
      ), false);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role), false) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_clients pc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id = pc.partner_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
      WHERE pu.user_id = _user_id AND pc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND pc.active = true
        AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
    )), false);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role), false) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_user_clients puc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu2 ON pu2.partner_id = puc.partner_id AND pu2.user_id = puc.user_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa2 ON pa2.id = puc.partner_id
      WHERE puc.user_id = _user_id AND puc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND puc.active = true
        AND pu2.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa2.ativo = true AND pa2.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu2.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu2.tenant_id = pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id
    ) OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_technician_clients ptc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu3 ON pu3.partner_id = ptc.partner_id AND pu3.user_id = ptc.technician_user_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa3 ON pa3.id = ptc.partner_id
      WHERE ptc.technician_user_id = _user_id AND ptc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND ptc.active = true
        AND pu3.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa3.ativo = true AND pa3.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu3.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu3.tenant_id = pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id
    )), false);
  END IF;

  RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes uc
    WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
      AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
      AND uc.is_active = true
      AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
      AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
  )), false);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_product_composition_core(p_produto_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_receita_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_p public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_produto_id IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 50 OR p_receita_offset IS NULL OR p_receita_offset < 0 OR p_receita_offset > 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_invalid_query'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_p FROM public.produtos WHERE id = p_produto_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_unavailable'; END IF;
  WITH rec AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.id AS formulacao_id, f.microrganismo_id, m.nome AS micro_nome, m.ativo AS micro_ativo, f.component_insumo_id,
           ip.nome AS insumo_nome, f.volume_ml, f.proporcao, f.concentracao, f.unidade, f.e_volume_fixo
    FROM public.formulacoes f JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = f.microrganismo_id
    LEFT JOIN public.produtos ip ON ip.id = f.component_insumo_id
    WHERE f.produto_id = p_produto_id ORDER BY f.created_at, f.id LIMIT p_limit + 1 OFFSET p_receita_offset
  ), dec AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.id, d.ordem::int AS ordem, d.tipo_componente, d.microrganismo_id, m.nome AS micro_nome, m.ativo AS micro_ativo,
           d.componente_nome, d.quantidade, d.unidade, d.base, d.natureza
    FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = d.microrganismo_id
    WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id ORDER BY d.ordem LIMIT 51
  )
  SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'produto', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',v_p.id,'nome',v_p.nome,'familia_catalogo',v_p.familia_catalogo,'updated_at',v_p.updated_at),
    'conjunto', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('status',c.status,'updated_at',c.updated_at)
                 FROM public.produto_composicao_conjuntos c WHERE c.produto_id = p_produto_id),
    'receita', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(r)) FROM (SELECT * FROM rec LIMIT p_limit) r), '[]'::jsonb),
    'receita_offset', p_receita_offset,
    'declaracoes', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.ordem) FROM (SELECT * FROM dec LIMIT 50) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'receita_has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > p_limit FROM rec),
    'declaracoes_has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > 50 FROM dec)) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
functions.name: read_global_product_composition_core

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_fazenda_dependencies(_fazenda_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_cliente uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT f.cliente_id INTO v_cliente FROM fazendas f WHERE f.id = _fazenda_id;
  -- H7O: staff operacional OU usuário com acesso ao cliente dono da fazenda.
  IF NOT (public.is_operational_staff(v_uid)
          OR (v_cliente IS NOT NULL AND public.can_user_access_cliente(v_uid, v_cliente))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: consulta de dependências restrita ao staff operacional ou ao escopo do cliente.';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'talhoes',               (SELECT count(*) FROM talhoes WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'ordens_servico',        (SELECT count(*) FROM ordens_servico WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'ordens_servico_onfarm', (SELECT count(*) FROM ordens_servico_onfarm WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'registros_consultor',   (SELECT count(*) FROM registros_consultor WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'portal_solicitacoes',   (SELECT count(*) FROM portal_solicitacoes WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'alertas_agronomicos',   (SELECT count(*) FROM alertas_agronomicos WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id),
    'clima_dados',           (SELECT count(*) FROM clima_dados WHERE fazenda_id = _fazenda_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_partner_order_sla()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r RECORD; s RECORD; v_dedupe text;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT po.id, po.numero, pa.nome_fantasia AS partner_nome
      FROM partner_orders po
      JOIN partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = po.partner_id
     WHERE po.status = 'aprovado' AND po.approved_at IS NOT NULL
  LOOP
    SELECT * INTO s FROM partner_order_sla_status(r.id);
    IF NOT FOUND OR NOT s.atrasada THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
    v_dedupe := 'sla_b2b:' || r.id || ':' || s.fase;
    INSERT INTO alertas_operacionais (
      tipo, origem, titulo, descricao, gravidade, status,
      referencia_tabela, referencia_id, chave_dedupe, metadata
    ) VALUES (
      'sla_pedido_b2b','sistema',
      'SLA estourado · ' || r.numero,
      'Pedido ' || r.numero || ' (' || r.partner_nome || ') está há ' ||
        ROUND(s.horas_decorridas,1) || 'h na fase ' || s.fase ||
        ' (limite ' || s.prazo_horas || 'h).',
      'alta','aberto','partner_orders', r.id, v_dedupe,
      jsonb_build_object('fase', s.fase, 'horas', s.horas_decorridas, 'prazo', s.prazo_horas)
    ) ON CONFLICT (chave_dedupe) DO NOTHING;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_talhao_dependencies(_talhao_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_cliente uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT f.cliente_id INTO v_cliente
    FROM talhoes t JOIN fazendas f ON f.id = t.fazenda_id
   WHERE t.id = _talhao_id;
  -- H7O: staff operacional OU usuário com acesso ao cliente dono do talhão.
  IF NOT (public.is_operational_staff(v_uid)
          OR (v_cliente IS NOT NULL AND public.can_user_access_cliente(v_uid, v_cliente))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: consulta de dependências restrita ao staff operacional ou ao escopo do cliente.';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ordens_servico',        (SELECT count(*) FROM ordens_servico WHERE talhao_id = _talhao_id),
    'ordens_servico_onfarm', (SELECT count(*) FROM ordens_servico_onfarm WHERE talhao_id = _talhao_id),
    'registros_consultor',   (SELECT count(*) FROM registros_consultor WHERE talhao_id = _talhao_id),
    'portal_solicitacoes',   (SELECT count(*) FROM portal_solicitacoes WHERE talhao_id = _talhao_id),
    'alertas_agronomicos',   (SELECT count(*) FROM alertas_agronomicos WHERE talhao_id = _talhao_id)
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_sync_mestre_preco(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_litro numeric;
  v_tiers integer;
BEGIN
  IF num_nonnulls(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN; END IF;

  SELECT litro, tiers INTO v_litro, v_tiers
  FROM public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id);

  IF COALESCE(v_tiers,0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN; -- sem apresentacao ativa: preserva fallback legado
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'on', true);

  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2),
             valor_ha_brl    = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dose_ml_ha,0) > 0
                                    THEN round(v_litro * (p.dose_ml_ha / 1000.0), 2) END
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR p.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL, valor_ha_brl = NULL
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_ha_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2)
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR m.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR m.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'off', true);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cockpit_ctx_programacao(p_programacao_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(programacao_id uuid, os_id uuid, origem text, produto_id uuid, microrganismo_id uuid, cliente_id uuid, partner_order_id uuid, volume_necessario numeric, status_os text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp record;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO pp FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id = p_programacao_id;
  IF pp IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COCKPIT_PROGRAMACAO_NAO_ENCONTRADA'; END IF;

  IF pp.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT pp.id, os.id, 'onfarm'::text, coalesce(pp.produto_id, os.produto_id),
             coalesce(pp.microrganismo_id, os.microrganismo_id), os.cliente_id,
             NULL::uuid, coalesce(pp.volume_necessario, 0), os.status::text
        FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os
       WHERE os.id = pp.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  ELSIF pp.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT pp.id, os.id,
             CASE WHEN os.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'b2b' ELSE 'manual' END,
             coalesce(pp.produto_id, os.produto_id),
             coalesce(pp.microrganismo_id, os.microrganismo_id), os.cliente_id,
             os.partner_order_id, coalesce(pp.volume_necessario, 0), os.status::text
        FROM public.ordens_servico os
       WHERE os.id = pp.ordem_servico_id;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COCKPIT_PROGRAMACAO_SEM_OS';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_selection_core(p_entity_type text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_include_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, nome text, ativo boolean, hidden boolean, selectable boolean, in_page boolean, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid; v_q text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
BEGIN
  IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo','cultura')
     OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
     OR (v_q IS NOT NULL AND char_length(v_q) > 80)
     OR (p_include_ids IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(p_include_ids) > 50 OR array_position(p_include_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor(CASE WHEN p_entity_type='cultura' THEN 'read_selection_cultura' ELSE 'read_catalog' END);
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.nome::text AS nome, p.ativo FROM public.produtos p WHERE p_entity_type='produto'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.nome::text, m.ativo FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE p_entity_type='microrganismo'
    UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.nome::text, c.ativo FROM public.culturas c WHERE p_entity_type='cultura'
  ), marked AS (
    SELECT b.*, COALESCE(v.hidden,false) AS hidden FROM base b
      LEFT JOIN public.catalog_tenant_visibility v ON v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type
       AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id,v.cultura_id)=b.id
  ), page AS (
    SELECT m.*, count(*) OVER () AS total FROM marked m
     WHERE m.ativo IS TRUE AND m.hidden IS FALSE
       AND (v_q IS NULL OR m.nome ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_') || '%')
     ORDER BY m.nome, m.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
  )
  SELECT pg.id, pg.nome, pg.ativo, pg.hidden, true, true, pg.total FROM page pg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.id, m.nome, m.ativo, m.hidden, (m.ativo IS TRUE AND m.hidden IS FALSE), false, NULL::bigint FROM marked m
   WHERE p_include_ids IS NOT NULL AND m.id = ANY(p_include_ids) AND m.id NOT IN (SELECT pg2.id FROM page pg2);
END; $function$
functions.name: catalog_tenant_selection_core

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dre_summary(_from date, _to date, _regime text DEFAULT 'COMPETENCIA'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(dre_group text, total numeric, qtd integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _regime = 'CAIXA' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH receitas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(rp.amount_received) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM receivable_payments rp
      JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
      WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      GROUP BY 1
    ),
    despesas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(pp.amount_paid) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM payable_payments pp
      JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
      WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      GROUP BY 1
    )
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM receitas
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM despesas;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH receitas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(ari.original_amount) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
      WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
      GROUP BY 1
    ),
    despesas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(api.original_amount) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
      WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
      GROUP BY 1
    )
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM receitas
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM despesas;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dashboard_kpis(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'receitas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'receitas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_received) FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'inadimplencia_total', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
    'pagar_vencidas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entregas WHERE financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * p.valor_litro_brl) FROM entregas e
        LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id WHERE e.financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'nfe_pendente_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0),
    'nfe_pendente_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_resolve_operation(_direction text, _origin_uf text, _destination_uf text, _crt text, _final_consumer boolean, _taxpayer_indicator text, _ncm text, _product_category text, _sales_channel text, _ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS fiscal_operation_policies
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE p public.fiscal_operation_policies%ROWTYPE; n_tie int;
BEGIN
  WITH cand AS (
    SELECT f.*,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.priority ASC,
             (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) DESC, f.valid_from DESC) AS rn,
           f.priority AS p_ord,
           (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) AS s_ncm,
           (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_dest,
           (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_orig,
           (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) AS s_ind,
           (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) AS s_fc
      FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies f
     WHERE f.policy_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND f.document_model = '55' AND f.active IS TRUE
       AND f.direction = _direction
       AND (f.origin_uf IS NULL OR f.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
       AND (f.destination_uf IS NULL OR f.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
       AND (f.crt IS NULL OR f.crt = _crt)
       AND (f.final_consumer IS NULL OR f.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
       AND (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR f.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
       AND (f.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE f.ncm_prefix || '%')
       AND (f.product_category IS NULL OR f.product_category = _product_category)
       AND (f.sales_channel IS NULL OR f.sales_channel = _sales_channel)
       AND f.valid_from <= _ref_date
       AND (f.valid_until IS NULL OR f.valid_until >= _ref_date)
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO n_tie
    FROM cand
   WHERE (p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, s_ind, s_fc, valid_from)
       = (SELECT p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, s_ind, s_fc, valid_from FROM cand WHERE rn = 1);

  IF n_tie IS NULL OR n_tie = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_OPERATION_POLICY_NOT_FOUND: sem politica publicada para direcao=% origem=% destino=% crt=% consumidorFinal=% indIEDest=% ncm=%',
      _direction, _origin_uf, _destination_uf, _crt, _final_consumer, _taxpayer_indicator, coalesce(_ncm,'-')
      USING HINT = 'Cadastre e publique a politica de operacao com CFOP, natureza, base legal e fonte oficial.';
  END IF;
  IF n_tie > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_OPERATION_POLICY_AMBIGUOUS: % politicas publicadas com a mesma precedencia efetiva (origem=%, destino=%).',
      n_tie, _origin_uf, _destination_uf
      USING HINT = 'Resolva a ambiguidade por priority/vigencia/especificidade antes de emitir.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO p FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies f
   WHERE f.policy_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND f.document_model = '55' AND f.active IS TRUE
     AND f.direction = _direction
     AND (f.origin_uf IS NULL OR f.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
     AND (f.destination_uf IS NULL OR f.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
     AND (f.crt IS NULL OR f.crt = _crt)
     AND (f.final_consumer IS NULL OR f.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
     AND (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR f.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
     AND (f.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE f.ncm_prefix || '%')
     AND (f.product_category IS NULL OR f.product_category = _product_category)
     AND (f.sales_channel IS NULL OR f.sales_channel = _sales_channel)
     AND f.valid_from <= _ref_date
     AND (f.valid_until IS NULL OR f.valid_until >= _ref_date)
   ORDER BY f.priority ASC, (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            f.valid_from DESC
   LIMIT 1;
  RETURN p;
END $function$
functions.name: fn_fiscal_resolve_operation

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_resolve_tax_rule(_tax_kind text, _crt text, _origin_uf text, _destination_uf text, _ncm text, _product_category text, _final_consumer boolean, _taxpayer_indicator text, _ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS fiscal_tax_rules
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.fiscal_tax_rules%ROWTYPE; n_tie int;
BEGIN
  IF _tax_kind IN ('IBS','CBS','IS') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_RTC_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: tributo % nao possui engine compativel nesta fase.', _tax_kind;
  END IF;

  WITH cand AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.priority ASC,
             (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC, (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, t.valid_from DESC, t.version DESC) AS rn,
           t.priority AS p_ord,
           (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) AS s_ncm,
           (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_dest,
           (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_orig
      FROM public.fiscal_tax_rules t
     WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       AND t.tax_kind = _tax_kind
       AND (t.crt IS NULL OR t.crt = _crt)
       AND (t.origin_uf IS NULL OR t.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
       AND (t.destination_uf IS NULL OR t.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
       AND (t.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE t.ncm_prefix || '%')
       AND (t.product_category IS NULL OR t.product_category = _product_category)
       AND (t.final_consumer IS NULL OR t.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
       AND (t.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR t.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
       AND t.valid_from <= _ref_date
       AND (t.valid_until IS NULL OR t.valid_until >= _ref_date)
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO n_tie
    FROM cand
   WHERE (p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, valid_from)
       = (SELECT p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, valid_from FROM cand WHERE rn = 1);

  IF n_tie IS NULL OR n_tie = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_NOT_FOUND: sem regra publicada para tributo=% crt=% origem=% destino=% ncm=%',
      _tax_kind, _crt, _origin_uf, _destination_uf, coalesce(_ncm,'-')
      USING HINT = 'Cadastre a regra com CST/CSOSN, parametros do tributo, base legal e fonte oficial, e publique-a. Ausencia de regra nunca e isencao.';
  END IF;
  IF n_tie > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_AMBIGUOUS: % regras publicadas com a mesma precedencia efetiva para tributo=% origem=% destino=%.',
      n_tie, _tax_kind, _origin_uf, _destination_uf
      USING HINT = 'Ajuste priority/vigencia/especificidade. O motor nunca escolhe silenciosamente.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.fiscal_tax_rules t
   WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.tax_kind = _tax_kind
     AND (t.crt IS NULL OR t.crt = _crt)
     AND (t.origin_uf IS NULL OR t.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
     AND (t.destination_uf IS NULL OR t.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
     AND (t.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE t.ncm_prefix || '%')
     AND (t.product_category IS NULL OR t.product_category = _product_category)
     AND (t.final_consumer IS NULL OR t.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
     AND (t.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR t.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
     AND t.valid_from <= _ref_date
     AND (t.valid_until IS NULL OR t.valid_until >= _ref_date)
   ORDER BY t.priority ASC, (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            t.valid_from DESC, t.version DESC
   LIMIT 1;

  -- Coerencia CRT em tempo de resolucao (defesa adicional a constraint).
  IF r.tax_kind IN ('ICMS','ICMS_ST') AND _crt IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF _crt IN ('1','2') AND r.csosn IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_CRT_INCOHERENT: emitente CRT % exige CSOSN na regra de %.', _crt, r.tax_kind;
    END IF;
    IF _crt IN ('3','4') AND r.cst IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_CRT_INCOHERENT: emitente CRT % exige CST de ICMS na regra de %.', _crt, r.tax_kind;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH g AS (
    SELECT (auth.uid() IS NULL
            OR public.fn_regulatory_can_read(auth.uid())
            OR public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid())
            OR public.can_view_catalog_internal(auth.uid())) AS ok
  ), d AS (
    SELECT * FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
     WHERE microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
       AND (SELECT ok FROM g)
     ORDER BY (status='VALIDATED') DESC, version DESC
     LIMIT 1)
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT ok FROM g) THEN NULL
              WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d) THEN NULL ELSE (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'dossier_id', d.id,
      'version', d.version,
      'status', d.status,
      'blocked_reason', d.blocked_reason,
      'regulatory_category', d.regulatory_category,
      'strain', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_code,'')),''), nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_name,'')),'')),
      'formulation', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.formulation,'')),''),
      'label_guarantee', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.label_guarantee,'')),''),
      'mapa_status', d.mapa_status,
      'mapa_registration_number', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_registration_number,'')),''),
      'mapa_holder', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_holder,'')),''),
      'mapa_valid_until', d.mapa_valid_until,
      'mapa_not_applicable_reason', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_not_applicable_reason,'')),''),
      'published_ncm', d.published_ncm,
      'published_cest', d.published_cest,
      'effective_from', d.effective_from,
      'effective_to', d.effective_to,
      'review_technical', d.technical_review_status,
      'review_regulatory', d.regulatory_review_status,
      'review_fiscal', d.fiscal_review_status,
      'has_label_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type='ROTULO'),
      'has_report_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type IN ('LAUDO','CERTIFICADO_ANALISE')),
      'expired_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                             WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL
                               AND x.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND x.valid_until < current_date),
      'ncm_approved', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.status='APPROVED'),
      'ncm_candidates', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_pending', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.item_key ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='PENDING'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_not_applicable', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                                      'item_key',c.item_key,'justification',c.justification) ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='NOT_APPLICABLE'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='CONFIRMED'),
      'presentations_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id),
      'presentations_units_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                           WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.units_confirmed),
      'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                          WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.gtin_confirmed))
    FROM d) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

  SELECT CASE

    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN false
    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=p_product_id AND p.familia_catalogo='biologico')
    WHEN p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id=p_microorganism_id)
    ELSE false END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.get_partner_user_lifecycle(p_partner_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_before_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; state jsonb; history jsonb; next_cursor jsonb;
BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 IF actor IS NULL OR org IS NULL OR platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(actor) IS NOT TRUE
 OR NOT public.has_role(actor,'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.is_platform_superadmin(actor)
 OR public.is_platform_superadmin(p_user_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id=org AND ativo AND status='ativa')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND organization_id=org AND ativo
   AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(user_id))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE id=p_partner_id AND commercial_owner_organization_id=org AND ativo AND deleted_at IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND (partner_id<>p_partner_id OR tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM org)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'c2_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR (p_before IS NULL)<>(p_before_id IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'c2_invalid_page' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 state:=jsonb_build_object('user',p_user_id,'partner',p_partner_id,'org',org,
   'roles',(SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text),ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id),
   'link',(SELECT to_jsonb(pu) FROM public.partner_users pu WHERE user_id=p_user_id),
   'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=p_user_id));
 -- Immutable log scoped by partner + target + tenant BOTH before and after.
 -- Return an explicit audit whitelist, never raw payload/receipt/profile data.
 WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM public.partner_audit_logs a
  WHERE a.partner_id=p_partner_id AND a.acao='c2_partner_lifecycle'
    AND a.dados_anteriores->>'user'=p_user_id::text AND a.dados_anteriores->>'org'=org::text
    AND a.dados_novos->'state'->>'user'=p_user_id::text AND a.dados_novos->'state'->>'org'=org::text
    AND (p_before IS NULL OR (a.created_at,a.id)<(p_before,p_before_id))
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT p_limit+1
 ), page AS (SELECT * FROM eligible ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT p_limit)
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',id,'at',created_at,'actor_id',usuario_id,'reason',dados_novos->>'reason',
    'action',dados_novos->'receipt'->>'action',
    'before',jsonb_build_object('roles',dados_anteriores->'roles','link',
      CASE WHEN dados_anteriores->'link'='null'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
       'partner_id',dados_anteriores->'link'->'partner_id','valid_from',dados_anteriores->'link'->'valid_from',
       'revoked_at',dados_anteriores->'link'->'revoked_at','version',dados_anteriores->'link'->'version') END),
    'after',jsonb_build_object('roles',dados_novos->'state'->'roles','link',
      CASE WHEN dados_novos->'state'->'link'='null'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
       'partner_id',dados_novos->'state'->'link'->'partner_id','valid_from',dados_novos->'state'->'link'->'valid_from',
       'revoked_at',dados_novos->'state'->'link'->'revoked_at','version',dados_novos->'state'->'link'->'version') END)
   ) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC) FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
   CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM eligible)>p_limit THEN
    (SELECT jsonb_build_object('at',created_at,'id',id) FROM page ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END
 INTO history,next_cursor;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('state',state,'version',md5(state::text),'history',history,'next_cursor',next_cursor);
END $function$
