CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_visit_selection_page(p_registro_id uuid, p_entity_type text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_include_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, nome text, familia_catalogo text, selectable boolean, in_page boolean, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid; v_q text:=NULLIF(btrim(p_search),'');
BEGIN
 v_org:=platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('read_prefs');
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.can_view_technical_visit(auth.uid(),p_registro_id),false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo')
 OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
 OR char_length(v_q)>80 OR cardinality(p_include_ids)>50 OR array_position(p_include_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id,p.nome::text,p.familia_catalogo::text,p.ativo FROM public.produtos p
   WHERE p_entity_type='produto' AND to_jsonb(p)->>'owner_organization_id' IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT m.id,m.nome::text,'microrganismo'::text,m.ativo FROM public.microrganismos m
   WHERE p_entity_type='microrganismo' AND to_jsonb(m)->>'owner_organization_id' IS NULL
 ), marked AS (
  SELECT b.*, b.ativo IS TRUE AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility v
   WHERE v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type AND v.hidden
    AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id)=b.id) AS eligible FROM base b
 ), page AS (
  SELECT m.*,count(*) OVER() AS total FROM marked m WHERE m.eligible
   AND (v_q IS NULL OR m.nome ILIKE '%'||replace(replace(replace(v_q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_')||'%')
   ORDER BY m.nome,m.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
 ) SELECT p.id,p.nome,p.familia_catalogo,p.eligible,true,p.total FROM page p
 UNION ALL SELECT m.id,m.nome,m.familia_catalogo,m.eligible,false,NULL::bigint FROM marked m
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_include_ids) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page p WHERE p.id=m.id)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes r WHERE r.registro_consultor_id=p_registro_id
      AND CASE WHEN p_entity_type='produto' THEN r.produto_biologico_sugerido_id ELSE r.microrganismo_id END=m.id);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_b2b_technician_clients_secure(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_technician_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(cliente_id uuid, nome text, razao_social text, nome_fantasia text, tipo_pessoa text, documento_mascarado text, telefone text, cidade text, estado text, ultima_simulacao_at timestamp with time zone, total_simulacoes bigint, assigned_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_is_comercial boolean;
  v_is_gestor boolean;
  v_is_tecnico boolean;
  v_user_partner uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth required';
  END IF;

  v_is_admin := public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::app_role);
  v_is_comercial := public.has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial'::app_role);
  v_is_gestor := public.has_role(v_uid, 'parceiro_b2b'::app_role);
  v_is_tecnico := public.has_role(v_uid, 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role);

  IF NOT (v_is_admin OR v_is_comercial OR v_is_gestor OR v_is_tecnico) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  IF v_is_gestor OR v_is_tecnico THEN
    v_user_partner := public.get_user_partner_id();
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH links AS (
    SELECT ptc.cliente_id, ptc.partner_id, ptc.technician_user_id, ptc.assigned_at
    FROM public.partner_technician_clients ptc
    WHERE ptc.active = true
      AND (
        v_is_admin OR v_is_comercial
        OR (v_is_gestor AND ptc.partner_id = v_user_partner)
        OR (v_is_tecnico AND ptc.technician_user_id = v_uid AND ptc.partner_id = v_user_partner)
      )
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ptc.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (
        p_technician_user_id IS NULL
        OR ptc.technician_user_id = p_technician_user_id
        OR v_is_tecnico -- técnico sempre restrito a si mesmo, ignora filtro externo
      )
      AND (NOT v_is_tecnico OR ptc.technician_user_id = v_uid)
  ),
  agg AS (
    SELECT l.cliente_id,
           MIN(l.assigned_at) AS assigned_at
    FROM links l
    GROUP BY l.cliente_id
  ),
  sims AS (
    SELECT ps.cliente_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           MAX(ps.created_at) AS ultima
    FROM public.partner_simulations ps
    WHERE ps.cliente_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ps.cliente_id
  )
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.nome,
    c.razao_social,
    c.nome_fantasia,
    c.tipo_pessoa,
    CASE
      WHEN c.cpf_cnpj IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN length(regexp_replace(c.cpf_cnpj, '\D', '', 'g')) = 11
        THEN '***.' || substring(regexp_replace(c.cpf_cnpj, '\D', '', 'g'), 4, 3) || '.***-**'
      WHEN length(regexp_replace(c.cpf_cnpj, '\D', '', 'g')) = 14
        THEN '**.' || substring(regexp_replace(c.cpf_cnpj, '\D', '', 'g'), 3, 3) || '.***/****-**'
      ELSE '***'
    END,
    c.telefone,
    c.endereco_municipio,
    c.endereco_estado,
    s.ultima,
    COALESCE(s.total, 0),
    a.assigned_at
  FROM agg a
  JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = a.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN sims s ON s.cliente_id = c.id
  ORDER BY c.nome NULLS LAST;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_catalog_search_v1(p_catalog_type text, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_parent_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_preferred_codes text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_limit integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, description text, parent_code text, metadata jsonb, is_preferred boolean, catalog_version text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH cat AS (
    SELECT id, source_version
    FROM public.fiscal_reference_catalogs
    WHERE catalog_type = p_catalog_type AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  needle AS (
    SELECT lower(translate(coalesce(p_query,''),
      'ÁÀÂÃÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇáàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç',
      'AAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc')) AS q
  )
  SELECT e.code, e.description, e.parent_code, e.metadata,
         (p_preferred_codes IS NOT NULL AND e.code = ANY (p_preferred_codes)) AS is_preferred,
         c.source_version
  FROM public.fiscal_reference_entries e
  JOIN cat c ON c.id = e.catalog_id
  CROSS JOIN needle n
  WHERE e.is_active
    AND (e.valid_from IS NULL OR e.valid_from <= current_date)
    AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= current_date)
    AND (p_parent_code IS NULL OR e.parent_code = p_parent_code)
    AND (n.q = '' OR e.search_text LIKE '%' || n.q || '%')
  ORDER BY
    (p_preferred_codes IS NOT NULL AND e.code = ANY (p_preferred_codes)) DESC,
    (n.q <> '' AND e.code LIKE n.q || '%') DESC,
    e.code
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce(p_limit, 25), 1), 30);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_bi_esteira_resumo(p_data_inicio timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() - '30 days'::interval), p_data_fim timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_cliente_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_fazenda_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_produto_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_origem_os text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.can_view_bi_operacional(v_uid) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'total_os', 0, 'ok', false, 'reason', 'sem_permissao'
    );
  END IF;

  WITH base AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM public.mv_esteira_laboratorio m
    WHERE m.created_at >= p_data_inicio
      AND m.created_at <= p_data_fim
      AND (p_cliente_id IS NULL OR m.cliente_id = p_cliente_id)
      AND (p_fazenda_id IS NULL OR m.fazenda_id = p_fazenda_id)
      AND (p_produto_id IS NULL OR m.produto_id = p_produto_id)
      AND (p_microrganismo_id IS NULL OR m.microrganismo_id = p_microrganismo_id)
      AND (p_origem_os IS NULL OR m.origem_os = p_origem_os)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR m.status_esteira_oficial = p_status)
      -- Escopo por consultor/técnico
      AND (
        public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrador') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'gestor')
        OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrativo') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'producao')
        OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'financeiro')
        OR (
          (public.has_role(v_uid, 'consultor_tecnico') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'tecnico_agronomo'))
          AND m.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(v_uid))
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total_os', count(*),
    'os_abertas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_os NOT IN ('finalizada','cancelada')),
    'os_finalizadas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_os = 'finalizada'),
    'os_atrasadas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE atrasado = true),
    'aguardando_cq', count(*) FILTER (WHERE cq_resultado IS NULL AND lote_id IS NOT NULL),
    'cq_aprovado', count(*) FILTER (WHERE cq_resultado = 'aprovado'),
    'cq_reprovado', count(*) FILTER (WHERE cq_resultado = 'reprovado'),
    'envases_realizados', count(*) FILTER (WHERE envase_id IS NOT NULL),
    'entregas_realizadas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE entrega_id IS NOT NULL),
    'entregas_confirmadas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE entrega_confirmada = true),
    'pendencias_bloqueantes', count(*) FILTER (WHERE array_length(bloqueios, 1) > 0),
    'pode_finalizar', count(*) FILTER (WHERE pode_finalizar = true),
    'volume_solicitado_l', coalesce(sum(volume_solicitado_l), 0),
    'tempo_medio_os_ate_entrega_h', coalesce(avg(tempo_os_ate_entrega), 0),
    'tempo_medio_cq_ate_envase_h', coalesce(avg(tempo_cq_ate_envase), 0),
    'por_status', (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(status_esteira_oficial,'sem_status'), qtd)
      FROM (SELECT status_esteira_oficial, count(*) AS qtd FROM base GROUP BY status_esteira_oficial) s
    ),
    'por_origem', (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(origem_os,'sem_origem'), qtd)
      FROM (SELECT origem_os, count(*) AS qtd FROM base GROUP BY origem_os) s
    ),
    'ok', true
  ) INTO v_result FROM base;

  RETURN coalesce(v_result, jsonb_build_object('total_os', 0, 'ok', true));
END;
$function$

 RETURNS uuid[]

 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 4 NF-e pendente
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'NF-e pendente'::text,
         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
    FROM financial_categories fc
   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 6 recorrências com falha
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
         0::numeric,
         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
         'centros-custo'::text
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
END $function$
functions.name: get_financial_alerts

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_cashflow(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_view_mode text DEFAULT 'PROJECTED'::text, p_group_by text DEFAULT 'DAY'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(period_label text, period_start date, expected_inflows numeric, expected_outflows numeric, realized_inflows numeric, realized_outflows numeric, projected_balance numeric, realized_balance numeric, accumulated_projected_balance numeric, accumulated_realized_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_trunc text; v_fmt text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_group_by IS NULL OR upper(p_group_by) NOT IN ('DAY','WEEK','MONTH') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Agrupamento invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_view_mode IS NULL OR upper(p_view_mode) NOT IN ('PROJECTED','REALIZED','COMPARATIVE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modo de visualizacao invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  v_trunc := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'WEEK' THEN 'week' WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END;
  v_fmt := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'MM/YYYY' WHEN 'WEEK' THEN '"Sem" IW/IYYY' ELSE 'DD/MM' END;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH proj_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, ari.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ari.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,ari.original_amount + COALESCE(ari.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(ari.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), proj_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, api.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN api.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,api.original_amount + COALESCE(api.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(api.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
     WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, rp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(rp.amount_received) v
      FROM receivable_payments rp
     WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, pp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(pp.amount_paid) v
      FROM payable_payments pp
     WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), buckets AS (
    SELECT b FROM proj_in UNION SELECT b FROM proj_out
    UNION SELECT b FROM real_in UNION SELECT b FROM real_out
  ), combined AS (
    SELECT b.b AS bk,
           COALESCE(pi.v,0)::numeric ei, COALESCE(po.v,0)::numeric eo,
           COALESCE(ri.v,0)::numeric ri_v, COALESCE(ro.v,0)::numeric ro_v
      FROM buckets b
      LEFT JOIN proj_in pi ON pi.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN proj_out po ON po.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_in ri ON ri.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_out ro ON ro.b = b.b
  )
  SELECT to_char(bk, v_fmt),
         bk,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE ei END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE eo END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ri_v END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ro_v END,
         (ei - eo)::numeric,
         (ri_v - ro_v)::numeric,
         SUM(ei - eo) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric,
         SUM(ri_v - ro_v) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric
    FROM combined
   ORDER BY bk;
END $function$
functions.name: get_financial_cashflow

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); s record; owner uuid;
BEGIN
 IF u IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(u)
  OR NOT public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,p_partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT pa.commercial_owner_organization_id INTO owner FROM public.partner_accounts pa
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id=pa.id
 JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id=pu.user_id
 JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE pa.id=p_partner_id AND pu.user_id=u
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now()
 AND pf.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND pf.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=o.id
 AND public.h15_actor_organization()=o.id;
 IF owner IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='pedidos_b2b')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='contas_receber') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN owner;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dre_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_regime text DEFAULT 'CASH'::text, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; g RECORD;
  v_groups jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_unclassified jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_receita numeric := 0; v_deducoes numeric := 0;
  v_resultado numeric := 0; v_margem numeric := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Período inválido';
  END IF;
  IF p_regime IS NULL OR upper(p_regime) NOT IN ('CASH','ACCRUAL') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Regime inválido';
  END IF;

  IF upper(p_regime) = 'ACCRUAL' THEN
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(ari.original_amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS qtd
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
        JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
       WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp), jsonb_build_object('total', g.total, 'qtd', g.qtd)); END LOOP;
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(api.original_amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS qtd
        FROM accounts_payable_installments api
        JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
       WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP
      v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp),
        COALESCE(v_groups->lower(g.grp),'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('total',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'total')::numeric,0) + g.total, 'qtd',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'qtd')::int,0) + g.qtd::int));
    END LOOP;
  ELSE
    -- CASH: NÃO filtrar is_reversal. O estorno tem valor negativo e cancela o pagamento original na soma.
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(rp.amount_received) AS total,
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(rp.is_reversal,false) = false) AS qtd
        FROM receivable_payments rp
        JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
        JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
       WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp), jsonb_build_object('total', g.total, 'qtd', g.qtd)); END LOOP;
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(pp.amount_paid) AS total,
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(pp.is_reversal,false) = false) AS qtd
        FROM payable_payments pp
        JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
        JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
       WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP
      v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp),
        COALESCE(v_groups->lower(g.grp),'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('total',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'total')::numeric,0) + g.total, 'qtd',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'qtd')::int,0) + g.qtd::int));
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name))
    INTO v_unclassified
    FROM financial_categories WHERE dre_group IS NULL AND active = true;

  v_receita := COALESCE((v_groups->'receita_bruta'->>'total')::numeric,0)
             + COALESCE((v_groups->'outras_receitas'->>'total')::numeric,0);
  v_deducoes := COALESCE((v_groups->'deducoes'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'custo_producao'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_variavel'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_fixa'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_administrativa'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_comercial'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_financeira'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'impostos'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'outras_despesas'->>'total')::numeric,0);
  v_resultado := v_receita - v_deducoes;
  v_margem := CASE WHEN v_receita > 0 THEN (v_resultado / v_receita) * 100 ELSE 0 END;

  r := v_groups
    || jsonb_build_object('resultado_operacional', v_resultado,
                          'margem_operacional_percentual', v_margem,
                          'unclassified_categories', COALESCE(v_unclassified, '[]'::jsonb));
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dashboard_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r jsonb;
  v_rec_expected numeric := 0; v_rec_received numeric := 0;
  v_rec_open numeric := 0; v_rec_overdue numeric := 0; v_rec_partial numeric := 0;
  v_rec_overdue_count int := 0; v_rec_avg_days int := 0;
  v_pay_expected numeric := 0; v_pay_paid numeric := 0;
  v_pay_open numeric := 0; v_pay_overdue numeric := 0; v_pay_partial numeric := 0;
  v_pay_overdue_count int := 0;
  v_nfe_count int := 0; v_nfe_amount numeric := 0;
  v_deliv_count int := 0; v_deliv_amount numeric := 0;
  v_rec_recurring numeric := 0; v_pay_recurring numeric := 0;
  v_rec_errors int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- A receber (previsto: pelo vencimento no período)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int,
         COALESCE(AVG((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0)::int
    INTO v_rec_expected, v_rec_open, v_rec_overdue, v_rec_partial, v_rec_overdue_count, v_rec_avg_days
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A receber (realizado: por payment_date)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0)
    INTO v_rec_received
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (previsto)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int
    INTO v_pay_expected, v_pay_open, v_pay_overdue, v_pay_partial, v_pay_overdue_count
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (realizado)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0)
    INTO v_pay_paid
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- NF-e pendente
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)
    INTO v_nfe_count, v_nfe_amount
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true
     AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING';

  -- Entregas pendentes faturamento
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)
    INTO v_deliv_count, v_deliv_amount
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL;

  -- Recorrências ativas
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='RECEIVABLE'),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='PAYABLE'),0)
    INTO v_rec_recurring, v_pay_recurring
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_rec_errors
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= ((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - INTERVAL '30 days');

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'total_receivable_expected', v_rec_expected,
    'total_receivable_received', v_rec_received,
    'total_receivable_open', v_rec_open,
    'total_receivable_overdue', v_rec_overdue,
    'total_receivable_partial', v_rec_partial,
    'overdue_receivables_count', v_rec_overdue_count,
    'average_days_overdue', v_rec_avg_days,
    'total_payable_expected', v_pay_expected,
    'total_payable_paid', v_pay_paid,
    'total_payable_open', v_pay_open,
    'total_payable_overdue', v_pay_overdue,
    'total_payable_partial', v_pay_partial,
    'overdue_payables_count', v_pay_overdue_count,
    'projected_balance', v_rec_expected - v_pay_expected,
    'realized_balance', v_rec_received - v_pay_paid,
    'collection_rate', CASE WHEN v_rec_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_rec_received / v_rec_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'payment_rate', CASE WHEN v_pay_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_pay_paid / v_pay_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_count', v_nfe_count,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_amount', v_nfe_amount,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_count', v_deliv_count,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_amount', v_deliv_amount,
    'active_recurring_receivables_amount', v_rec_recurring,
    'active_recurring_payables_amount', v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_net_balance', v_rec_recurring - v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_generation_errors_count', v_rec_errors
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations(p_partner_id uuid, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_before_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE owner uuid; rows jsonb;
BEGIN
 owner:=platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id);
 IF (p_before IS NULL) <> (p_before_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_cursor' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(q.value ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO rows FROM (
 SELECT ar.id,ar.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',ar.id,'order_id',po.id,'numero',po.numero,
 'created_at',ar.created_at,'total',ar.total_amount,'status',ar.status,
 'installments',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'numero',i.installment_number,
 'vencimento',i.due_date,'valor',i.original_amount,'recebido',i.received_amount,'status',i.status)
 ORDER BY i.installment_number,i.id) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id),'[]'::jsonb)) value
 FROM public.partner_orders po JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id=po.id
 JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id=l.receivable_id
 WHERE po.partner_id=p_partner_id AND l.partner_id=p_partner_id AND ar.partner_id=p_partner_id
 AND ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ar.origin_id=po.id AND ar.organization_id=owner
 -- A title with an ambiguous order/link or foreign/unowned installment is not projected.
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.receivable_id=ar.id)=1
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.partner_order_id=po.id)=1
 AND ar.total_amount>=0 AND ar.total_amount::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id
  AND (i.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM owner OR i.original_amount IS NULL OR i.received_amount IS NULL
   OR i.original_amount<0 OR i.received_amount<0 OR i.original_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR i.received_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')))
 AND (p_before IS NULL OR (ar.created_at,ar.id)<(p_before,p_before_id))
 ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC,ar.id DESC LIMIT 50
 ) q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_OWN_OBLIGATIONS_V1','partner_id',p_partner_id,
 'rows',rows,'limit',50,'documents_enabled',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_production_planning_detail(p_planning_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial')
       OR public.has_role(v_uid,'producao') OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'planning', to_jsonb(pp.*),
    'partner', to_jsonb(pa.*),
    'order', to_jsonb(po.*),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', poi.id,
        'product_id', poi.product_id,
        'produto_nome', COALESCE(poi.produto_nome_snapshot, pr.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(poi.produto_codigo_snapshot, pr.codigo),
        'produto_tipo', pr.tipo,
        'quantidade', poi.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade'),
        'dose_ml_ha', pr.dose_ml_ha,
        'modo_aplicacao', pr.modo_aplicacao,
        -- Lista completa de microrganismos (suporta consórcios)
        'microrganismos', COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', m.id,
            'nome', m.nome,
            'codigo', m.codigo,
            'tipo', m.tipo,
            'concentracao', f.concentracao,
            'concentracao_unidade', f.unidade
          ) ORDER BY m.nome)
          FROM public.formulacoes f
          JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = f.microrganismo_id
          WHERE f.produto_id = poi.product_id
        ), CASE WHEN poi.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            (SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', m2.id, 'nome', m2.nome, 'codigo', m2.codigo, 'tipo', m2.tipo,
                'concentracao', NULL, 'concentracao_unidade', NULL))
             FROM public.microrganismos m2 WHERE m2.id = poi.microrganismo_id)
           ELSE '[]'::jsonb END),
        'vasilhame_volume_ml', cv.volume_ml,
        'vasilhame_rotulo', cv.rotulo,
        'volume_unitario_l', CASE
                               WHEN cv.volume_ml IS NOT NULL THEN cv.volume_ml / 1000.0
                               WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'litro' THEN 1
                               WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'ml' THEN 1/1000.0
                               ELSE NULL END,
        'volume_total_l', CASE
                            WHEN cv.volume_ml IS NOT NULL THEN (cv.volume_ml * poi.quantidade) / 1000.0
                            WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'litro' THEN poi.quantidade
                            WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'ml' THEN poi.quantidade / 1000.0
                            ELSE NULL END,
        'qtd_vasilhames', poi.quantidade,
        'os_id', (SELECT l.ordem_servico_id FROM public.production_order_link l WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id),
        'os_numero', (SELECT os.numero_os FROM public.production_order_link l JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = l.ordem_servico_id WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id),
        'os_status', (SELECT os.status FROM public.production_order_link l JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = l.ordem_servico_id WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id)
      )) FROM public.partner_order_items poi
        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = poi.product_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT cv2.volume_ml, cv2.rotulo
            FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv2
           WHERE cv2.item_tipo = 'produto'
             AND cv2.produto_id = poi.product_id
             AND cv2.ativo = true
           ORDER BY
             (cv2.preco_brl = COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) DESC,
             ABS(cv2.preco_brl - COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) ASC
           LIMIT 1
        ) cv ON true
        WHERE poi.order_id = po.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'timeline', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t.*) ORDER BY t.event_at)
        FROM public.production_timeline_events t WHERE t.partner_order_id = po.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'has_orders', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link WHERE planning_id = pp.id)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.production_planning pp
  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pp.partner_id
  JOIN public.partner_orders po ON po.id = pp.partner_order_id
  WHERE pp.id = p_planning_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_customer_statement(_customer_id uuid, _from date, _to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH entregas_periodo AS (
    SELECT e.id, e.receivable_id
    FROM entregas e
    WHERE e.cliente_id = _customer_id
      AND e.status = 'entregue'::status_entrega
      AND COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ),
  delivered_links AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ep.receivable_id
    FROM entregas_periodo ep
    WHERE ep.receivable_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  delivered AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.total_amount),0) AS total
    FROM delivered_links dl
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = dl.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND ar.customer_id = _customer_id
  ),
  delivered_meta AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ep.receivable_id IS NULL) AS unlinked
    FROM entregas_periodo ep
  ),
  billed AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.total_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND ar.issue_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ),
  pagamentos AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS liquido
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ),
  open_bal AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0)),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'customer_id', _customer_id,
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', _from, 'to', _to),
    'delivered', (SELECT total FROM delivered),
    'delivered_basis', 'accounts_receivable_linked_to_confirmed_deliveries',
    'delivered_deliveries_count', (SELECT total_deliveries FROM delivered_meta),
    'delivered_unlinked_count', (SELECT unlinked FROM delivered_meta),
    'billed', (SELECT total FROM billed),
    'cash_basis', 'NET_OF_REVERSALS',
    'received', (SELECT liquido FROM pagamentos),
    'received_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM pagamentos),
    'received_net_of_reversals', (SELECT liquido FROM pagamentos),
    'open_balance', (SELECT total FROM open_bal)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_requirement_resolve(p_sales_channel text, p_operation_type text, p_uf text, p_scope_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_scope_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_ex record; v_pol record;
BEGIN
  IF p_scope_type IS NOT NULL AND p_scope_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_ex FROM public.fiscal_requirement_exemptions
     WHERE active AND scope_type = p_scope_type AND scope_id = p_scope_id LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', false, 'status','EXEMPT', 'source','exemption',
        'exemption_id', v_ex.id, 'motivo', v_ex.motivo, 'approved_by', v_ex.approved_by);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_pol FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies
   WHERE active AND sales_channel = p_sales_channel AND operation_type = p_operation_type
     AND (uf IS NULL OR uf = p_uf)
     AND valid_from <= p_ref_date AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= p_ref_date)
   ORDER BY (uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, valid_from DESC LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', v_pol.requires_invoice,
      'status', CASE WHEN v_pol.requires_invoice THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,
      'source','policy','policy_id', v_pol.id, 'document_model', v_pol.document_model);
  END IF;

  -- Fail-closed: nunca assume NOT_REQUIRED em silêncio
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', true, 'status','PENDING_PARAMETRIZATION',
    'source','pending_parametrization', 'policy_id', NULL,
    'motivo','Nenhuma política fiscal cadastrada para o canal/operação/UF — parametrização contábil pendente');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_monthly_financial(_from date, _to date, _cost_center uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _regime text DEFAULT 'CASH'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL OR _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH rec AS (
    -- regime caixa líquido: inclui linhas de estorno (amount_received negativo)
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS total,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  pag AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0) AS total,
           COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid) FILTER (WHERE pp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments i ON i.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  prev_rec AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE i.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  prev_pag AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_payable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE i.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  overdue_rec AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0)),0) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS qty
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  overdue_pay AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS qty FROM accounts_payable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  nfe_pend AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS qty FROM accounts_receivable ar
    WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED' AND (
      ar.fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
      OR (COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required,false)=true
          AND COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status,'PENDING') <> 'ISSUED'))
  ),
  by_cat AS (
    SELECT fc.name AS category,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS received,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS received_gross
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
    GROUP BY fc.name
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', _from, 'to', _to),
    'regime', _regime,
    'cash_basis', 'NET_OF_REVERSALS',
    'received', (SELECT total FROM rec),
    'received_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM rec),
    'paid', (SELECT total FROM pag),
    'paid_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM pag),
    'expected_receivable', (SELECT total FROM prev_rec),
    'expected_payable', (SELECT total FROM prev_pag),
    'net_cash', (SELECT total FROM rec) - (SELECT total FROM pag),
    'overdue_receivable_total', (SELECT total FROM overdue_rec),
    'overdue_receivable_count', (SELECT qty FROM overdue_rec),
    'overdue_payable_count', (SELECT qty FROM overdue_pay),
    'nfe_pending_count', (SELECT qty FROM nfe_pend),
    'by_category', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'category',category,'received',received,'received_gross',received_gross)) FROM by_cat), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_payables(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, payable_id uuid, supplier text, description text, category text, due_date date, amount numeric, paid numeric, balance numeric, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _from date := (_filters->>'from')::date;
        _to date := (_filters->>'to')::date;
        _status text := _filters->>'status';
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, ap.id, COALESCE(ap.supplier_name,'—'), ap.description, fc.name,
         i.due_date, i.original_amount,
         COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0),
         i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0),
         i.status
  FROM accounts_payable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
  LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
  WHERE (_from IS NULL OR i.due_date >= _from)
    AND (_to IS NULL OR i.due_date <= _to)
    AND (_status IS NULL OR i.status = _status)
    AND ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_user_cliente_access(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid, _levels text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['read'::text, 'execute'::text, 'manage'::text])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'public'

BEGIN

    RETURN false;

    RETURN false;

  IF public.has_role(_user_id, 'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN
    RETURN true;

  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.user_clientes uc
     WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
       AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
       AND uc.is_active = true
       AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
       AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
       AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
       AND uc.access_level::text = ANY(_levels)
  );
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_top_financial_rankings(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; v_top_clientes jsonb; v_top_rec_cat jsonb; v_top_desp_cat jsonb; v_top_inad jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_clientes FROM (
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome AS customer_name,
           SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric AS total_revenue,
           COALESCE(SUM(ari.received_amount),0)::numeric AS received_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
             FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0)::numeric AS open_amount
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
     ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_rec_cat FROM (
    SELECT fc.id AS category_id, fc.name AS category_name, SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric AS total_amount
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_desp_cat FROM (
    SELECT fc.id AS category_id, fc.name AS category_name, SUM(api.original_amount)::numeric AS total_amount
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
     WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_inad FROM (
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome AS customer_name,
           SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))::numeric AS overdue_amount,
           COUNT(*)::int AS overdue_count,
           MAX((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)::int AS max_days_overdue
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
     WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
     GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
     ORDER BY overdue_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'top_customers_revenue', v_top_clientes,
    'top_revenue_categories', v_top_rec_cat,
    'top_expense_categories', v_top_desp_cat,
    'top_overdue_customers', v_top_inad
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$
functions.name: get_top_financial_rankings

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_completed_visit_presence(p_registro_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total integer; v_ok integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_registro_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;

  WITH elegiveis AS (
    SELECT r.consultor_profile_id AS user_id
      FROM public.registros_consultor r
     WHERE r.id = p_registro_id AND r.consultor_profile_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT tva.user_id FROM public.technical_visit_assignments tva
     WHERE tva.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id AND tva.is_active = true
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total FROM elegiveis;

  IF COALESCE(v_total,0) = 0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;

  WITH elegiveis AS (
    SELECT r.consultor_profile_id AS user_id
      FROM public.registros_consultor r
     WHERE r.id = p_registro_id AND r.consultor_profile_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT tva.user_id FROM public.technical_visit_assignments tva
     WHERE tva.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id AND tva.is_active = true
  ),
  eventos AS (
    SELECT vc.consultor_id, vc.tipo_checkin, vc.data_hora_checkin, vc.created_at, vc.id
      FROM public.visitas_checkin vc
      JOIN elegiveis e ON e.user_id = vc.consultor_id
     WHERE vc.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id
       AND vc.status <> 'inconsistente'::public.status_checkin
  ),
  ultimo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (consultor_id) consultor_id, tipo_checkin, data_hora_checkin
      FROM eventos
     ORDER BY consultor_id, data_hora_checkin DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC
  ),
  ultima_entrada AS (
    SELECT consultor_id, MAX(data_hora_checkin) AS dt_entrada
      FROM eventos
     WHERE tipo_checkin <> 'checkout'::public.tipo_checkin
     GROUP BY consultor_id
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_ok
    FROM ultimo u JOIN ultima_entrada e ON e.consultor_id = u.consultor_id
   WHERE u.tipo_checkin = 'checkout'::public.tipo_checkin
     AND u.data_hora_checkin > e.dt_entrada;

  RETURN v_ok = v_total;
END; $function$

 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT x.* INTO v_order FROM public.partner_orders x
  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=x.partner_id
  JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=x.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
  WHERE x.id=p_order_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(x.cliente_id);

  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

  IF v_order.cliente_id IS NULL
     OR NOT platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(v_order.cliente_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'header', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_order.id,
      'numero', v_order.numero,
      'status', v_order.status,
      'created_at', v_order.created_at,
      'requested_delivery_date', v_order.requested_delivery_date,
      'estimated_delivery_date', v_order.estimated_delivery_date,
      'approved_at', v_order.approved_at,
      'partner_id', v_order.partner_id,
      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
      'total', v_order.total,
      'origin_simulation_id', v_order.origin_simulation_id,
      'cultura', v_order.cultura,
      'area_total_ha', v_order.area_total_ha
    ),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', it.id,
        'nome', COALESCE(it.produto_nome_snapshot, p.nome, m.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(it.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
        'item_tipo', CASE WHEN it.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL AND it.product_id IS NULL THEN 'microrganismo' ELSE 'produto' END,
        'quantidade', it.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', it.unidade_medida,
        'volume_ml', it.volume_ml,
        'preco_unitario', it.preco_unitario,
        'subtotal', it.subtotal,
        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', p.nome,
          'codigo', p.codigo,
          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
                'nome', mf.nome,
                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
              )
            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
            FROM public.formulacoes f
            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) END,
        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', m.nome,
          'codigo', m.codigo,
          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
        ) END
      ) ORDER BY it.created_at)
      FROM public.partner_order_items it
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = it.product_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = it.microrganismo_id
      WHERE it.order_id = v_order.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
  WHERE pa.id = v_order.partner_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
functions.name: get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

    po.created_at,
    po.requested_delivery_date,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_simulation_detail_secure(p_simulation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sim public.partner_simulations%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT x.* INTO v_sim FROM public.partner_simulations x
  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=x.partner_id
  JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=x.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
  WHERE x.id=p_simulation_id AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(x.cliente_id);

  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

  IF v_sim.cliente_id IS NULL
     OR NOT platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(v_sim.cliente_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
  END IF;

  IF v_sim.status::text NOT IN ('enviada_gestor', 'convertida_pedido') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'simulation_not_visible';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'header', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_sim.id,
      'titulo', v_sim.titulo,
      'status', v_sim.status,
      'total_cheio', v_sim.total_cheio,
      'created_at', v_sim.created_at,
      'updated_at', v_sim.updated_at,
      'converted_order_id', v_sim.converted_order_id,
      'partner_id', v_sim.partner_id,
      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
      'cultura', v_sim.cultura,
      'area_total_ha', v_sim.area_total_ha,
      'objetivo_tecnico', v_sim.objetivo_tecnico
    ),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', si.id,
        'nome', COALESCE(si.produto_nome_snapshot, si.nome, p.nome, m.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(si.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
        'item_tipo', si.item_tipo,
        'quantidade', si.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', si.unidade_medida,
        'volume_ml', si.volume_ml,
        'valor_unitario_cheio', si.valor_unitario_cheio,
        'subtotal', si.subtotal,
        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', p.nome,
          'codigo', p.codigo,
          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
                'nome', mf.nome,
                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
              )
            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
            FROM public.formulacoes f
            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) END,
        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', m.nome,
          'codigo', m.codigo,
          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
        ) END
      ) ORDER BY si.created_at)
      FROM public.partner_simulation_items si
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = si.product_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = si.microrganismo_id
      WHERE si.simulation_id = v_sim.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
  WHERE pa.id = v_sim.partner_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NOT platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(NEW.partner_id,true)
 OR NOT platform_private.has_ticket('c2p1_settings_write',NEW.partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_SETTINGS_WRITE_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
 OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payment_methods WHERE active IS TRUE AND name=NEW.default_payment_method)<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF NEW.credit_limit::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.credit_limit<0
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1>NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FINANCIAL_VALUES_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_partner_engagement(p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_last timestamptz; v_30 int; v_90 int;
BEGIN
  SELECT MAX(created_at), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days')
  INTO v_last, v_30, v_90
  FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;

  VALUES (p_partner_id, v_last,
          CASE WHEN v_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM now() - v_last)::int END,
          COALESCE(v_30,0), COALESCE(v_90,0), now())
  ON CONFLICT (partner_id) DO UPDATE SET
    ultima_compra = EXCLUDED.ultima_compra,
    dias_sem_compra = EXCLUDED.dias_sem_compra,
    pedidos_30d = EXCLUDED.pedidos_30d,
    pedidos_90d = EXCLUDED.pedidos_90d,
    updated_at = now();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_invoice_apply_authorization_v1(_invoice_id uuid, _access_key text, _protocol text, _dh_recbto timestamp with time zone, _c_stat text, _x_motivo text, _transmission_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_inv public.fiscal_invoices%ROWTYPE; v_xml uuid;
BEGIN
  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(_protocol,'')),'') IS NULL
     OR coalesce(_access_key,'') !~ '^[0-9]{44}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_AUTHORIZATION_PAYLOAD_INVALID';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_inv FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE id = _invoice_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_INVOICE_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  IF coalesce(v_inv.environment,'HOMOLOGATION') = 'PRODUCTION' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT_BLOCKED';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotente: documento ja autorizado nunca e reescrito.
  IF v_inv.normalized_status = 'AUTHORIZED' THEN
    IF coalesce(v_inv.access_key,'') <> _access_key THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT: documento ja autorizado com outra chave.';
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', v_inv.id, 'applied', false,
      'normalizedStatus', v_inv.normalized_status,
      'reconciliationStatus', v_inv.reconciliation_status);
  END IF;

  -- Evidencia do XML assinado ja armazenado. O nfeProc (XML + protocolo) ainda
  -- nao e montado pelo transporte: enquanto nao existir, a nota fica PENDING.
  SELECT r.id INTO v_xml
    FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs r
   WHERE r.fiscal_invoice_id = _invoice_id
     AND r.signed_path IS NOT NULL
     AND (r.access_key IS NULL OR r.access_key = _access_key)
   ORDER BY coalesce(r.signed_at, r.updated_at) DESC LIMIT 1;

  UPDATE public.fiscal_invoices
     SET status = 'ISSUED',
         normalized_status = 'AUTHORIZED',
         access_key = _access_key,
         authorized_at = coalesce(_dh_recbto, now()),
         provider_status_raw = coalesce(_c_stat, provider_status_raw),
         tax_authority_notes = coalesce(_x_motivo, tax_authority_notes),
         -- xml_document_id NAO e sobrescrito aqui: o nfeProc protocolado ainda
         -- nao e gerado/armazenado pelo transporte (gate documentado).
         reconciliation_status = 'PENDING',
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = _invoice_id;

  INSERT INTO public.fiscal_audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, old_values, new_values, changed_by)
  VALUES ('fiscal_invoices', _invoice_id, 'UPDATE',
          jsonb_build_object('normalizedStatus', v_inv.normalized_status, 'status', v_inv.status),
          jsonb_build_object('normalizedStatus','AUTHORIZED','status','ISSUED',
                             'accessKey', _access_key, 'protocol', _protocol,
                             'transmissionId', _transmission_id,
                             'signedXmlRunId', v_xml,
                             'protocoledXmlStored', false), NULL);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', _invoice_id, 'applied', true,
    'normalizedStatus','AUTHORIZED',
    'reconciliationStatus','PENDING',
    'signedXmlRunId', v_xml,
    'protocoledXmlStored', false);
END $function$

 RETURNS uuid

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid;
BEGIN

  PERFORM public._cpp_validate_payload(p_payload);

  INSERT INTO public.commercial_payment_plans (
    name, code, description, plan_type, max_days, months_count, installment_count,
    discount_percent, monthly_interest_percent, interest_type, requires_credit_approval,

  ) VALUES (
    btrim(p_payload->>'name'), upper(btrim(p_payload->>'code')), nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payload->>'description','')),''),
    p_payload->>'plan_type', coalesce((p_payload->>'max_days')::integer,0),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'months_count')::numeric,0), coalesce((p_payload->>'installment_count')::integer,1),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'discount_percent')::numeric,0), coalesce((p_payload->>'monthly_interest_percent')::numeric,0),
    coalesce(p_payload->>'interest_type','compound'), coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_credit_approval')::boolean,false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_guarantee')::boolean,false), coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_financial_approval')::boolean,false),
    nullif(p_payload->>'minimum_order_amount','')::numeric, coalesce(p_payload->>'pricing_mode','discount_from_base'),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_admin_list_commercial_plans(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, description text, plan_type text, version integer, root_plan_id uuid, superseded_by_id uuid, valid_from timestamp with time zone, valid_until timestamp with time zone, is_default boolean, active boolean, sort_order integer, max_days integer, months_count numeric, installment_count integer, discount_percent numeric, monthly_interest_percent numeric, interest_type text, pricing_mode text, minimum_order_amount numeric, requires_credit_approval boolean, requires_guarantee boolean, requires_financial_approval boolean, is_referenced boolean, selectable boolean, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),100);
        v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_b2b_can_admin_plans() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT p.* FROM public.commercial_payment_plans p
    WHERE (p_search IS NULL OR btrim(p_search) = ''
           OR p.name ILIKE '%'||btrim(p_search)||'%' OR p.code ILIKE '%'||btrim(p_search)||'%')
      AND (coalesce(p_status,'all') = 'all'
           OR (p_status = 'active' AND p.active)
           OR (p_status = 'inactive' AND NOT p.active))
  ), counted AS (SELECT count(*)::bigint c FROM base)
  SELECT b.id, b.code, b.name, b.description, b.plan_type, b.version,
         b.root_plan_id, b.superseded_by_id, b.valid_from, b.valid_until,
         b.is_default, b.active, b.sort_order, b.max_days, b.months_count,
         b.installment_count, b.discount_percent, b.monthly_interest_percent,
         b.interest_type, b.pricing_mode, b.minimum_order_amount,
         b.requires_credit_approval, b.requires_guarantee, b.requires_financial_approval,
         public.fn_b2b_plan_referenced(b.id), public.fn_b2b_plan_selectable(b.id),
         (SELECT c FROM counted)
  FROM base b
  ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.code ASC, b.version DESC
  LIMIT v_limit OFFSET v_offset;
END
$function$
functions.name: rpc_admin_list_commercial_plans

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_admin_list_communication_dead_letter(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, canal comunicacao_canal, template_chave text, template_versao integer, attempts integer, max_attempts integer, error_code text, error_message text, recipient_user_id uuid, recipient_cliente_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_limit int; v_offset int;
BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIF3_GLOBAL_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  PERFORM public._comunicacao_require_admin();
  v_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(200, COALESCE(p_limit, 50)));
  v_offset := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_offset, 0));
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT o.id, o.canal, o.template_chave, o.template_versao,
           o.attempts, o.max_attempts,
           left(COALESCE(o.error_code,''), 80),
           left(COALESCE(o.error_message,''), 500),
           o.recipient_user_id, o.recipient_cliente_id,
           o.created_at, o.updated_at
      FROM public.comunicacao_outbox o

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_admin_version_commercial_plan(p_plan_id uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_motivo text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_old public.commercial_payment_plans%ROWTYPE; v_new_id uuid; v_next integer; v_code text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_b2b_can_admin_plans() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  PERFORM public._cpp_validate_payload(p_payload);

  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM public.commercial_payment_plans WHERE id = p_plan_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan_not_found'; END IF;
  IF v_old.superseded_by_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan_already_superseded'; END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(max(version),0) + 1 INTO v_next
    FROM public.commercial_payment_plans WHERE root_plan_id = coalesce(v_old.root_plan_id, v_old.id);
  v_code := upper(btrim(coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'code',''), v_old.code)));
  IF v_code = v_old.code THEN v_code := v_code || '-V' || v_next; END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.commercial_payment_plans (
    name, code, description, plan_type, max_days, months_count, installment_count,
    discount_percent, monthly_interest_percent, interest_type, requires_credit_approval,
    requires_guarantee, requires_financial_approval, minimum_order_amount, pricing_mode,
    active, sort_order, created_by, updated_by, valid_from, valid_until,
    version, root_plan_id, version_reason
  ) VALUES (
    btrim(coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'name',''), v_old.name)), v_code,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payload->>'description','')),''), v_old.description),
    coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'plan_type',''), v_old.plan_type),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'max_days')::integer, v_old.max_days),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'months_count')::numeric, v_old.months_count),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'installment_count')::integer, v_old.installment_count),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'discount_percent')::numeric, v_old.discount_percent),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'monthly_interest_percent')::numeric, v_old.monthly_interest_percent),
    coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'interest_type',''), v_old.interest_type),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_credit_approval')::boolean, v_old.requires_credit_approval),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_guarantee')::boolean, v_old.requires_guarantee),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'requires_financial_approval')::boolean, v_old.requires_financial_approval),
    coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'minimum_order_amount','')::numeric, v_old.minimum_order_amount),
    coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'pricing_mode',''), v_old.pricing_mode),
    true, v_old.sort_order, auth.uid(), auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'valid_from','')::timestamptz, now()),
    nullif(p_payload->>'valid_until','')::timestamptz,
    v_next, coalesce(v_old.root_plan_id, v_old.id), nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_motivo,'')),'')
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

  UPDATE public.commercial_payment_plans
     SET superseded_by_id = v_new_id, active = false, is_default = false,
         valid_until = coalesce(valid_until, now()), updated_by = auth.uid()
   WHERE id = p_plan_id;

  PERFORM public._cpp_audit('commercial_plan_versioned', v_new_id, to_jsonb(v_old), p_payload || jsonb_build_object('version', v_next, 'previous_plan_id', p_plan_id), p_motivo);
  RETURN v_new_id;
END
$function$
