CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_atualizar_identificacao_visita(p_registro_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_reg public.registros_consultor%ROWTYPE;
  v_new_version integer;
BEGIN
  v_reg := public._visita_lock_and_check(p_registro_id, p_expected_version, false);

  IF NOT public.is_technical_visit_editable_status(v_reg.status::text) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'status_nao_editavel' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Política: chave ausente = mantém valor atual; chave presente = aplica valor
  -- (string vazia ou null limpam campos opcionais: safra, fase_fenologica, objetivo_visita).
  UPDATE public.registros_consultor SET
    cultura_id      = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'cultura_id'
                             THEN NULLIF(p_payload->>'cultura_id','')::uuid ELSE cultura_id END,
    data_vistoria   = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'data_vistoria'
                             THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'data_vistoria','')::date, data_vistoria) ELSE data_vistoria END,
    tipo_visita     = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'tipo_visita'
                             THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'tipo_visita','')::tipo_visita, tipo_visita) ELSE tipo_visita END,
    objetivo_visita = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'objetivo_visita'
                             THEN NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'objetivo_visita','')),'') ELSE objetivo_visita END,
    safra           = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'safra'
                             THEN NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'safra','')),'') ELSE safra END,
    fase_fenologica = CASE WHEN p_payload ? 'fase_fenologica'
                             THEN NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'fase_fenologica','')),'') ELSE fase_fenologica END,
    version         = COALESCE(version, 1) + 1,
    updated_at      = now()
  WHERE id = p_registro_id
  RETURNING version INTO v_new_version;

  INSERT INTO public.visitas_logs (registro_consultor_id, usuario_id, acao, descricao, metadata)
  VALUES (p_registro_id, auth.uid(), 'identificacao_atualizada', 'Identificação da visita atualizada',
          jsonb_build_object('version', v_new_version, 'campos', (SELECT jsonb_agg(k) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) k)));

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'version', v_new_version);
END;
$function$
functions.name: rpc_atualizar_identificacao_visita

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_aging(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, parceiros integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: aging B2B restrito a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id,
           (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
           GREATEST(0, (current_date - ari.due_date)) AS dias
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ), faixas AS (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN dias <= 30 THEN '0-30'
             WHEN dias <= 60 THEN '31-60'
             WHEN dias <= 90 THEN '61-90'
             ELSE '90+'
           END AS faixa, partner_id, saldo
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT faixa, COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0), COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id)::int
  FROM faixas GROUP BY faixa
  ORDER BY CASE faixa WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END
$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_aging

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_partner_projection()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c jsonb; result jsonb; permitted boolean:=false; catalog boolean:=false; sheets boolean:=false; finance boolean:=false; u uuid:=auth.uid();
BEGIN
 c:=platform_private.b2b_commercial_context();
 IF c IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'codigo',p.codigo,'razao_social',p.razao_social,
   'nome_fantasia',p.nome_fantasia,'ativo',p.ativo,'papel',c->>'papel','mode',c->>'mode')
 INTO result FROM public.partner_accounts p
 WHERE p.id=(c->>'partner_id')::uuid AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND p.commercial_owner_organization_id=(c->>'commercial_owner_organization_id')::uuid;
 IF result IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 -- A commercial client alone is NOT a partner capability. Reuse current B2B
 -- chain, including singleton role/link validator; add freshness/owner proof.
 permitted:=COALESCE(platform_private.b2b_phase1_partner_visible((result->>'id')::uuid,true),false)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu
    JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id=pu.user_id
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
    WHERE pu.user_id=u AND pu.partner_id=(result->>'id')::uuid
      AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now()
      AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
      AND p.ativo AND p.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=o.id
      AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pa.id));
 IF permitted THEN
  catalog:=public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b') AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='catalogo_precos');
  sheets:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='fichas_tecnicas');
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 finance:=platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner((result->>'id')::uuid) IS NOT NULL;
 EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN finance:=false; END;
 RETURN result||jsonb_build_object('finance_capabilities',jsonb_build_object(
 'contract','C2_OWN_OBLIGATIONS_V1','obligations_read',finance))||jsonb_build_object('contract',c->>'contract','actor_id',c->'actor_id','tenant_id',c->'tenant_id','external_roles',c->'external_roles','manager',c->'manager','technician',c->'technician','producer_links_valid',c->'producer_links_valid')||jsonb_build_object('capabilities',jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_CAT_V1',
   'catalog_read',catalog,'sheets_read',sheets))||jsonb_build_object('order_capabilities',jsonb_build_object(
   'contract','C2_OWNER_ORDER_V1','order_create', permitted AND catalog

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_capacity_kpis()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'producao'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH os AS (
    SELECT os.status::text AS status,
           COALESCE(os.volume_total_ml, 0) / 1000.0 AS litros,
           os.updated_at,
           os.partner_order_id
    FROM public.ordens_servico os
    WHERE os.origem = 'b2b' AND os.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  litros AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('aberta','em_producao') THEN litros ELSE 0 END) AS litros_programados,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'em_producao' THEN litros ELSE 0 END) AS litros_em_producao,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finalizada' THEN litros ELSE 0 END) AS litros_produzidos,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finalizada' AND updated_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) THEN litros ELSE 0 END) AS producao_semana,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finalizada' AND updated_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) THEN litros ELSE 0 END) AS producao_mes
    FROM os
  ),
  pedidos AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'em_producao') AS pedidos_em_producao,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'aprovado' AND ready_for_production = false) AS aguardando_planejamento,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'aprovado' AND ready_for_production = true
                        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link pol WHERE pol.partner_order_id = po.id)) AS aguardando_producao,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'entregue') AS pedidos_entregues,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status::text = 'entregue' THEN
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(os2.volume_total_ml),0)/1000.0
               FROM public.ordens_servico os2 WHERE os2.partner_order_id = po.id)
          ELSE 0 END) AS litros_entregues
    FROM public.partner_orders po
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'litros_programados', COALESCE((SELECT litros_programados FROM litros), 0),
    'litros_em_producao', COALESCE((SELECT litros_em_producao FROM litros), 0),
    'litros_produzidos', COALESCE((SELECT litros_produzidos FROM litros), 0),
    'litros_entregues', COALESCE((SELECT litros_entregues FROM pedidos), 0),
    'producao_semana', COALESCE((SELECT producao_semana FROM litros), 0),
    'producao_mes', COALESCE((SELECT producao_mes FROM litros), 0),
    'pedidos_em_producao', COALESCE((SELECT pedidos_em_producao FROM pedidos), 0),
    'aguardando_planejamento', COALESCE((SELECT aguardando_planejamento FROM pedidos), 0),
    'aguardando_producao', COALESCE((SELECT aguardando_producao FROM pedidos), 0),
    'pedidos_entregues', COALESCE((SELECT pedidos_entregues FROM pedidos), 0)
  ) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_capacity_kpis

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_carteira_kpis(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.id, ar.issue_date, ari.original_amount, ari.received_amount, ari.due_date, ari.status, ari.paid_at
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'carteira_total', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0),
    'carteira_recebida', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount),0),
    'carteira_vencida', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'carteira_aberto', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'receita_mes', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('month',now())),0),
    'receita_ano', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('year',now())),0),
    'inadimplencia_pct', CASE WHEN SUM(original_amount) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0)/SUM(original_amount))*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    'prazo_medio_recebimento', ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (paid_at - issue_date))/86400) FILTER (WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL),0)::numeric,2),
    'ticket_medio', CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT id),2) ELSE 0 END
  ) INTO v
  FROM base
  WHERE (p_from IS NULL OR issue_date >= p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR issue_date <= p_to);
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_executive_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb; kpis jsonb; fc jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  kpis := rpc_b2b_carteira_kpis(NULL,NULL);
  fc := rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(NULL);

  WITH topp AS (
    SELECT pa.id, COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia,pa.razao_social) AS nome, COALESCE(SUM(po.total),0) AS total
    FROM partner_orders po
    JOIN partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = po.partner_id
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND po.created_at >= date_trunc('year',now())
    GROUP BY pa.id, pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social
    ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
  ),
  topprod AS (
    SELECT pr.id, pr.nome, COALESCE(SUM(poi.subtotal),0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantidade),0) AS qtd
    FROM partner_order_items poi
    JOIN partner_orders po ON po.id = poi.order_id
    JOIN produtos pr ON pr.id = poi.product_id
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND po.created_at >= date_trunc('year',now())
    GROUP BY pr.id, pr.nome
    ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', kpis,
    'forecast', fc,
    'parceiros_ativos', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_accounts WHERE ativo=true AND deleted_at IS NULL),
    'parceiros_bloqueados', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id) FROM partner_orders WHERE status='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'),
    'score_medio', (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score),2),0) FROM partner_risk_scores),
    'top_parceiros', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'total',total)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM topp),
    'top_produtos', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('produto_id',id,'nome',nome,'total',total,'quantidade',qtd)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM topprod)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_executive_alerts()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH credit AS (
    SELECT pa.id, pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social, pfs.credit_limit,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount)
        FROM accounts_receivable ar
        JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
        WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ar.partner_id = pa.id
          AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0) AS aberto
    FROM partner_accounts pa
    LEFT JOIN partner_financial_settings pfs ON pfs.partner_id = pa.id
    WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(pfs.credit_limit,0) > 0
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT id, COALESCE(nome_fantasia, razao_social) AS nome, credit_limit, aberto,
      ROUND((aberto/credit_limit)*100,2) AS pct
    FROM credit
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'acima_80', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'pct',pct,'aberto',aberto,'limite',credit_limit))
                 FROM classed WHERE pct >= 80 AND pct < 90),
    'acima_90', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'pct',pct,'aberto',aberto,'limite',credit_limit))
                 FROM classed WHERE pct >= 90),
    'bloqueados', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',po.partner_id,'numero',po.numero))
                   FROM partner_orders po WHERE po.status = 'aguardando_aprovacao_credito'),
    'com_vencidos', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',prs.partner_id,'vencidos',prs.titulos_vencidos,'dias',prs.dias_medio_atraso))
                     FROM partner_risk_scores prs WHERE prs.titulos_vencidos > 0),
    'score_critico', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',prs.partner_id,'score',prs.score))
                      FROM partner_risk_scores prs WHERE prs.risk_level = 'critico'),
    'receita_em_risco', (rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(NULL)->>'em_risco')::numeric
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_list_selectable_payment_plans()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, description text, plan_type text, max_days integer, months_count numeric, installment_count integer, discount_percent numeric, monthly_interest_percent numeric, interest_type text, pricing_mode text, minimum_order_amount numeric, requires_credit_approval boolean, requires_guarantee boolean, requires_financial_approval boolean, is_default boolean, sort_order integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  v_admin := public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::app_role)
          OR public.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro'::app_role)
          OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial'::app_role);
  IF NOT (v_admin OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.description, p.plan_type::text,
         p.max_days, p.months_count, p.installment_count,
         p.discount_percent, p.monthly_interest_percent,
         p.interest_type::text, p.pricing_mode::text, p.minimum_order_amount,
         p.requires_credit_approval, p.requires_guarantee, p.requires_financial_approval,
         p.is_default, p.sort_order
  FROM public.commercial_payment_plans p
  WHERE p.active = true
    AND p.superseded_by_id IS NULL
    AND p.valid_from <= now()
    AND (p.valid_until IS NULL OR p.valid_until > now())
    AND (
      v_admin
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.commercial_payment_plan_assignments a
          JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id = a.partner_id
         WHERE a.plan_id = p.id
           AND a.status = 'published'
           AND a.buyer_scope = 'partner'
           AND pu.user_id = v_uid
           AND a.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE
           AND (a.valid_until IS NULL OR a.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
      )
    )
  ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.name;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_partner_profitability(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_id uuid, partner_name text, total_comprado numeric, total_recebido numeric, total_aberto numeric, ticket_medio numeric, qtd_pedidos integer, prazo_medio_pgto numeric, inadimplencia_pct numeric, risk_score integer, risk_level text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: rentabilidade B2B restrita a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH pedidos AS (
    SELECT po.partner_id, COUNT(*) AS qtd, SUM(po.total) AS total
    FROM partner_orders po
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR po.created_at >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR po.created_at <= (p_to + 1))
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR po.partner_id = p_partner_id)
    GROUP BY po.partner_id
  ),
  recebidos AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      SUM(ari.received_amount) AS rec,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS aberto,
      AVG(CASE WHEN ari.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ari.paid_at - ar.issue_date))/86400 END) AS prazo_med,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS vencido
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
    GROUP BY ar.partner_id
  )
  SELECT pa.id, COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
    COALESCE(p.total,0),
    COALESCE(r.rec,0),
    COALESCE(r.aberto,0),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.qtd,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(p.total/p.qtd,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(p.qtd,0)::int,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.prazo_med,0)::numeric,2),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(r.vencido,0)/p.total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(prs.score,0),
    COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')
  FROM partner_accounts pa
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN recebidos r ON r.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = pa.id
  WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR pa.id = p_partner_id)
    AND (p.qtd IS NOT NULL OR r.rec IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(p.total,0) DESC;
END
$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_partner_profitability

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH conf AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c30,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 60 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c60,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 90 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c90
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  proj AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS p30
    FROM partner_orders WHERE receivable_generated = false
      AND status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  risk AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) AS r
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = ar.partner_id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE OR COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')='critico')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_bi_fluxo_visitas_resumo(p_data_inicio timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() - '30 days'::interval), p_data_fim timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_cliente_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_fazenda_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_consultor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status_solicitacao text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status_visita text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.can_view_bi_operacional(v_uid) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('total_visitas', 0, 'ok', false, 'reason', 'sem_permissao');
  END IF;

  WITH base AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM public.mv_fluxo_visita_tecnica m
    WHERE m.created_at >= p_data_inicio
      AND m.created_at <= p_data_fim
      AND (p_cliente_id IS NULL OR m.cliente_id = p_cliente_id)
      AND (p_fazenda_id IS NULL OR m.fazenda_id = p_fazenda_id)
      AND (p_consultor_id IS NULL OR m.consultor_id = p_consultor_id)
      AND (p_status_solicitacao IS NULL OR m.status_solicitacao = p_status_solicitacao)
      AND (p_status_visita IS NULL OR m.status_visita = p_status_visita)
      AND (
        public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrador') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'gestor')
        OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrativo') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'producao')
        OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'financeiro')
        OR (
          (public.has_role(v_uid, 'consultor_tecnico') OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'tecnico_agronomo'))
          AND (m.consultor_id = v_uid OR m.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(v_uid)))
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total_visitas', count(*),
    'solicitacoes_abertas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_solicitacao NOT IN ('concluida','cancelada','convertida_os')),
    'com_checkin', count(*) FILTER (WHERE possui_checkin = true),
    'com_diagnostico', count(*) FILTER (WHERE possui_diagnostico = true),
    'com_evidencias', count(*) FILTER (WHERE possui_evidencias = true),
    'com_recomendacao', count(*) FILTER (WHERE possui_recomendacao = true),
    'convertidas_em_os', count(*) FILTER (WHERE possui_os = true),
    'aprovadas', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_aprovacao = 'aprovado'),
    'em_atraso', count(*) FILTER (WHERE array_length(bloqueios, 1) > 0),
    'dias_medios_em_aberto', coalesce(avg(dias_em_aberto), 0),
    'tempo_medio_solicitacao_ate_checkin_h', coalesce(avg(tempo_solicitacao_ate_checkin), 0),
    'por_status_solicitacao', (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(status_solicitacao,'sem_status'), qtd)
      FROM (SELECT status_solicitacao, count(*) AS qtd FROM base GROUP BY status_solicitacao) s
    ),
    'por_status_visita', (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(status_visita,'sem_status'), qtd)
      FROM (SELECT status_visita, count(*) AS qtd FROM base GROUP BY status_visita) s
    ),
    'por_consultor', (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(consultor_nome, consultor_id::text, 'sem_consultor'), qtd)
      FROM (SELECT consultor_id, consultor_nome, count(*) AS qtd FROM base GROUP BY consultor_id, consultor_nome ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20) s
    ),
    'ok', true
  ) INTO v_result FROM base;

  RETURN coalesce(v_result, jsonb_build_object('total_visitas', 0, 'ok', true));
END;
$function$

 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';

    RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.commercial_campaigns SET
      nome = COALESCE(p_payload->>'nome', nome),
      descricao = COALESCE(p_payload->>'descricao', descricao),
      data_inicio = COALESCE((p_payload->>'data_inicio')::date, data_inicio),
      data_fim = COALESCE((p_payload->>'data_fim')::date, data_fim),
      ativa = COALESCE((p_payload->>'ativa')::boolean, ativa),
      updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_id RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_xml_status_v1(p_invoice_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_runs jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
  PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(p_invoice_id);

  IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN: perfil sem permissao para consultar execucoes de XML.';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'runId', r.id, 'runVersion', r.run_version, 'state', r.state,
           'engineVersion', r.engine_version, 'schemaVersion', r.schema_version,
           'accessKey', r.access_key, 'environmentCode', r.environment_code,
           'payloadSha256', r.payload_sha256,
           'unsignedSha256', r.unsigned_sha256, 'unsignedBytes', r.unsigned_bytes,
           'signedSha256', r.signed_sha256, 'signedBytes', r.signed_bytes,
           'hasUnsigned', r.unsigned_path IS NOT NULL,
           'hasSigned', r.signed_path IS NOT NULL,
           'validation', r.validation, 'signature', r.signature_metadata,
           'errorCode', r.error_code,
           'preparedAt', r.prepared_at, 'generatedAt', r.generated_at,
           'validatedAt', r.validated_at, 'signedAt', r.signed_at, 'failedAt', r.failed_at)
           ORDER BY r.run_version DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_runs
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs WHERE public.h15_invoice_access(fiscal_invoice_id)) r
   WHERE r.fiscal_invoice_id = p_invoice_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', p_invoice_id, 'ceiling','SIGNED', 'runs', v_runs);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cc_bulk_adjust_preview(p_ids uuid[], p_percent numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_ids)=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_ids) x(id) WHERE x.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i WHERE i.id=x.id AND platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'id',i.id,'pricing_mode',i.pricing_mode,
           'current_price',i.condition_price,'current_discount',i.discount_percent,
           'new_price', CASE WHEN i.pricing_mode='fixed_item_price'
                             THEN round(i.condition_price*(1+p_percent/100.0),2) END,
           'new_discount', CASE WHEN i.pricing_mode='discount_from_base'
                                THEN LEAST(100,GREATEST(0,round(i.discount_percent+p_percent,4))) END)),'[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
   WHERE i.id = ANY(p_ids) AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('preview', v);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cc_validate_matrix(p_plan_id uuid, p_buyer_scope text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_missing jsonb; v_drafts int; v_quote int;
BEGIN
 IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_buyer_scope,p_partner_id,p_customer_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tipo',tipo,'id',id,'nome',nome)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_missing
  FROM (
    SELECT 'produto' tipo, p.id, p.nome FROM public.produtos p
     WHERE COALESCE(p.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.product_id=p.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'microrganismo', m.id, m.nome FROM public.microrganismos m
     WHERE COALESCE(m.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.microrganismo_id=m.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
  ) s;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE pricing_mode='quote_only')
    INTO v_drafts, v_quote
  FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices
   WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(assignment_id,plan_id,buyer_scope,partner_id,customer_id) AND plan_id=p_plan_id AND buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
     AND partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
     AND customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', jsonb_array_length(v_missing)=0,
    'missing_items', v_missing, 'draft_count', COALESCE(v_drafts,0), 'quote_only_count', COALESCE(v_quote,0));
END $function$
functions.name: rpc_cc_validate_matrix

        'identity_args', pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),
        'owner', pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),
        'security_definer', p.prosecdef,
        'config', COALESCE(array_to_string(p.proconfig, ','), ''),
        'acl', COALESCE(array_to_string(p.proacl::text[], ' | '), 'DEFAULT'),
        'anon_execute', has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE'),
        'public_execute', p.proacl IS NULL OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.proacl::text[]) a WHERE a LIKE '=%'
        ),
        'authenticated_execute', has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE'),
        'md5', md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))
      ))
      FROM pg_proc p
      JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
      WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = ANY(p_functions)
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'triggers', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'table', c.relname,
        'trigger', t.tgname,
        'enabled', t.tgenabled
      ))
      FROM pg_trigger t
      JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
      JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname = ANY(p_tables)
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_commercial_consolidated_dashboard(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_consultor uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_region text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_partner_type text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_from date := COALESCE(p_from, (now() - interval '30 days')::date);
        v_to date := COALESCE(p_to, now()::date);
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'parceiros_ativos', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE ativo
      AND (p_region IS NULL OR commercial_region = p_region)
      AND (p_partner_type IS NULL OR partner_type::text = p_partner_type)
      AND (p_consultor IS NULL OR consultor_responsavel = p_consultor)),
    'parceiros_inativos', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE NOT ativo),
    'parceiros_novos', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE created_at::date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to),
    'receita_aprovada', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.partner_orders po
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = po.partner_id
      WHERE po.created_at::date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
        AND po.status::text IN ('aprovado','em_producao','pronto_entrega','entregue','faturado')
        AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR po.partner_id = p_partner_id)
        AND (p_region IS NULL OR pa.commercial_region = p_region)
        AND (p_partner_type IS NULL OR pa.partner_type::text = p_partner_type)
        AND (p_consultor IS NULL OR pa.consultor_responsavel = p_consultor)),
    'receita_entregue', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.partner_orders
      WHERE created_at::date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to AND status::text = 'entregue'),
    'receita_faturada', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM public.partner_orders
      WHERE created_at::date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to AND status::text = 'faturado'),
    'pedidos_em_ajuste', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_orders WHERE status::text = 'aguardando_ajuste_comercial'),
    'pedidos_aguardando_aprovacao', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_orders WHERE status::text IN ('solicitado','em_analise_comercial')),
    'campanhas_ativas', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.commercial_campaigns WHERE ativa AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN data_inicio AND data_fim),
    'periodo', jsonb_build_object('from', v_from, 'to', v_to)
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_commercial_kpis(p_from date DEFAULT ((now())::date - 30), p_to date DEFAULT (now())::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_consultor uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_region text DEFAULT NULL::text)

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'

  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')) THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
 -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
 -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
 -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_cashflow(_from date, _to date, _granularity text DEFAULT 'day'::text, _mode text DEFAULT 'projected'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket date, entradas numeric, saidas numeric, saldo numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_trunc text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  v_trunc := CASE _granularity WHEN 'week' THEN 'week' WHEN 'month' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END;

  IF _mode = 'realized' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH ent AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, payment_date)::date AS b, SUM(amount_received) AS v
                 FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1),
         sai AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, payment_date)::date AS b, SUM(amount_paid) AS v
                 FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1)
    SELECT COALESCE(e.b, s.b),
           COALESCE(e.v,0)::numeric,
           COALESCE(s.v,0)::numeric,
           (COALESCE(e.v,0) - COALESCE(s.v,0))::numeric
    FROM ent e FULL JOIN sai s ON s.b = e.b
    ORDER BY 1;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH ent AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, due_date)::date AS b,
                        SUM(GREATEST(0,original_amount + COALESCE(interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))) AS v
                 FROM accounts_receivable_installments
                 WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1),
         sai AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, due_date)::date AS b,
                        SUM(GREATEST(0,original_amount + COALESCE(interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))) AS v
                 FROM accounts_payable_installments
                 WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1)
    SELECT COALESCE(e.b, s.b),
           COALESCE(e.v,0)::numeric,
           COALESCE(s.v,0)::numeric,
           (COALESCE(e.v,0) - COALESCE(s.v,0))::numeric
    FROM ent e FULL JOIN sai s ON s.b = e.b
    ORDER BY 1;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_commercial_owner_orders_core(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org uuid;
  v_orders jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Organização canônica do ator derivada no servidor: perfil ativo + org ativa.
  -- profiles.user_id tem índice único exato (pin acima, nesta transação), logo a
  -- resolução é determinística; o LIMIT 1 é defensivo. Nunca vem de parâmetro.
  SELECT p.organization_id INTO v_org
    FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
   WHERE p.user_id = v_uid
     AND p.ativo = true
     AND o.ativo = true
     AND o.status = 'ativa'
   LIMIT 1;

  IF v_org IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'actor_scope_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Somente administração interna da empresa dona da carteira. Papéis externos
  -- (parceiro_b2b etc.) não autorizam; superadmin sem papel interno também é
  -- negado aqui — o canal do fornecedor é a lista administrativa existente.
  -- Papel misto (administrador + papel externo) resolve pela org do perfil ativo.
  IF NOT (platform_private.has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'actor_not_allowed' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'id', q.id,
           'numero', q.numero,
           'status', q.status,
           'total', q.total,
           'created_at', q.created_at,
           'requested_delivery_date', q.requested_delivery_date,
           'estimated_delivery_date', q.estimated_delivery_date,
           'partner_id', q.partner_id,
           'partner_razao_social', q.razao_social,
           'c2_external_origin_snapshot', q.c2_external_origin_snapshot
         ) ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_orders
    FROM (
      SELECT o.id, o.numero, o.status::text AS status, o.total, o.created_at,
             o.requested_delivery_date, o.estimated_delivery_date,
             o.partner_id, o.c2_external_origin_snapshot,
             pa.razao_social
        FROM public.partner_orders o
        JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = o.partner_id
       WHERE pa.commercial_owner_organization_id = v_org
         AND pa.ativo IS TRUE
         AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND (p_status IS NULL OR o.status::text = p_status)
         AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR o.partner_id = p_partner_id)
         AND (p_start IS NULL OR o.created_at >= p_start)
         AND (p_end IS NULL OR o.created_at <= p_end)
       ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id
       LIMIT 200
    ) q;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'contract', 'C2_COMMERCIAL_OWNER_ORDERS_V1',
    'organization_id', v_org,
    'orders', v_orders
  );
END;
$function$
functions.name: c2_commercial_owner_orders_core
functions.signature: platform_private.c2_commercial_owner_orders_core(text,uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_admin_user_links(p_user_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid; v_items jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_users_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT organization_id INTO v_org FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND ativo=true;
 IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_users_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_user_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_user_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR array_position(p_user_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_users_invalid_input' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'user_id',p.user_id,
   'expected_version',platform_private.user_edit_f2_version(p.user_id),
   'clientes',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('cliente_id',c.id,'nome',c.nome,'principal',uc.principal,'status_cliente',c.status_cliente,
       'vigente',(uc.is_active AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from<=now()) AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until>now())))
       ORDER BY uc.principal DESC,c.nome,c.id)
     FROM public.user_clientes uc JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=uc.cliente_id AND c.organization_id=v_org WHERE uc.user_id=p.user_id),'[]'::jsonb),
   'parceiro',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('partner_id',pa.id,'razao_social',pa.razao_social,'papel',pu.papel,'ativo',(pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL))
     FROM public.partner_users pu JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=v_org WHERE pu.user_id=p.user_id ORDER BY pu.created_at,pu.id LIMIT 1),
   'parceiros_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users pu JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=v_org WHERE pu.user_id=p.user_id),
   'fora_do_alcance',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_clientes uc LEFT JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=uc.cliente_id WHERE uc.user_id=p.user_id AND c.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_org)
     +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users pu LEFT JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id WHERE pu.user_id=p.user_id AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_org)
 ) ORDER BY p.user_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_items
 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=ANY(p_user_ids) AND p.organization_id=v_org AND NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(p.user_id);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('items',v_items);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_attempt_journal_write_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Also fences old function bodies in flight and arbitrary old/downgraded clients.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.partner_id,NEW.idempotency_key,NEW.created_by)
  IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.partner_id,OLD.idempotency_key,OLD.created_by) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Fail BEFORE any scope lock; this trigger NEVER acquires scope (old body may hold idem).
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal j
  WHERE j.actor_id=auth.uid() AND j.partner_id=NEW.partner_id AND j.idempotency_key=btrim(NEW.idempotency_key)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_REGISTERED_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('b2b_idem:'||NEW.partner_id::text||':'||btrim(NEW.idempotency_key),0));
 PERFORM platform_private.c2_partner_order_attempt_authz(auth.uid(),NEW.partner_id);
 IF NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_ACTOR_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal j JOIN public.profiles p
  ON p.user_id=j.actor_id AND p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.ativo
  WHERE j.actor_id=auth.uid() AND j.partner_id=NEW.partner_id AND j.idempotency_key=btrim(NEW.idempotency_key)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_SCOPE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.name: c2_attempt_journal_write_guard

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_preview_administrative_broadcast_count(p_target_role app_role)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total_users int := 0; v_by_canal jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; v_rule record;
BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIF3_GLOBAL_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'apenas administrador ou gestor' USING ERRCODE='insufficient_privilege'; END IF;
  IF p_target_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'target_role obrigatório'; END IF;
  SELECT count(DISTINCT pr.user_id) INTO v_total_users
    FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id = ur.user_id
   WHERE ur.role = p_target_role AND COALESCE(pr.ativo,true) = true;
  FOR v_rule IN
    SELECT canal, count(DISTINCT pr.user_id) AS n
      FROM public.comunicacao_regras r
      JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.role = r.perfil
      JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id = ur.user_id
     WHERE r.event_key = 'administrative_important_update'
       AND r.enabled = true AND r.estrategia = 'broadcast_role'
       AND r.perfil = p_target_role AND COALESCE(pr.ativo,true) = true
       AND public._comunicacao_can_deliver(pr.user_id, NULL, r.canal)
     GROUP BY canal
  LOOP
    v_by_canal := v_by_canal || jsonb_build_object(v_rule.canal::text, v_rule.n);
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'target_role',p_target_role,
    'total_users_in_role',v_total_users,'estimated_recipients_by_canal',v_by_canal);
END$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_reg public.registros_consultor;
BEGIN
  IF NOT coalesce(public.technical_actor_ready(v_uid),false)
    OR NOT coalesce(public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid,p_registro_id),false) THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$
functions.name: fn_b2b_credit_exposure

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_cart_hash(p_partner_id uuid, p_plan_id uuid, p_cart jsonb, p_final numeric)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(
    'v2|' || COALESCE(p_partner_id::text,'-') || '|' || COALESCE(p_plan_id::text,'-') || '|' ||
    to_char(ROUND(COALESCE(p_final,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo','')      || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'item_id','')        || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida','') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'pricing_mode','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'price_source','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'rule_id','')        || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'line_final_amount')::numeric,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00'),
        ';' ORDER BY COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'item_id',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida',''),
                     COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE(l->>'rule_id',''))
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_cart->'lines','[]'::jsonb)) l
    ),'') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((p_cart->>'quote_required'),'false')
  ,'UTF8')),'hex')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cockpit_stage(p_status_oficial text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE lower(coalesce(p_status_oficial, ''))
    WHEN 'cancelada'        THEN 'cancelada'
    WHEN 'cancelado'        THEN 'cancelada'
    WHEN 'finalizada'       THEN 'finalizada'
    WHEN 'finalizado'       THEN 'finalizada'
    WHEN 'entregue'         THEN 'entregue'
    WHEN 'aplicado'         THEN 'entregue'
    WHEN 'em_entrega'       THEN 'em_entrega'
    WHEN 'estoque_reservado' THEN 'estoque_reservado'
    WHEN 'estoque_gerado'   THEN 'estoque_disponivel'
    WHEN 'pronto_entrega'   THEN 'estoque_disponivel'
    WHEN 'envase'           THEN 'em_envase'
    WHEN 'em_envase'        THEN 'em_envase'
    WHEN 'cq_reprovado'     THEN 'cq_reprovado'
    WHEN 'reprovado'        THEN 'cq_reprovado'
    WHEN 'cq_aprovado'      THEN 'cq_aprovado'
    WHEN 'aprovado_cq'      THEN 'cq_aprovado'
    WHEN 'aguardando_cq'    THEN 'aguardando_cq'
    WHEN 'em_cq'            THEN 'aguardando_cq'
    WHEN 'em_producao'      THEN 'em_producao'
    WHEN 'programada'       THEN 'programada'
    ELSE 'aguardando'
  END
$function$
functions.name: fn_cockpit_stage

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  e            public.entregas%ROWTYPE;
  v_emitente   jsonb;
  v_destino    jsonb;
  v_os         jsonb;
  v_itens      jsonb;
  v_transporte jsonb;
  v_receb      jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_UNAUTHENTICATED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id = p_entrega_id;
  IF e.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_ENTREGA_NAO_ENCONTRADA';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'razao_social', cs.legal_name,
           'nome_fantasia', cs.trade_name,
           'cnpj', cs.cnpj,
           'inscricao_estadual', cs.state_registration,
           'email', cs.fiscal_email,
           'telefone', cs.phone,
           'logradouro', cs.street,
           'numero', cs.number,
           'complemento', cs.complement,
           'bairro', cs.neighborhood,
           'cidade', cs.city,
           'uf', cs.state,
           'cep', cs.postal_code
         )
    INTO v_emitente
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) cs
   WHERE cs.is_active
   ORDER BY cs.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'cliente_id', c.id,
           'nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.razao_social), ''), c.nome),
           'nome_fantasia', c.nome_fantasia,
           'cpf_cnpj', c.cpf_cnpj,
           'telefone', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.telefone), ''), e.destinatario_telefone),
           'email', c.email,
           'cidade', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_cidade), ''), c.endereco_municipio),
           'uf', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_uf), ''), c.endereco_estado)
         )
    INTO v_destino
    FROM public.clientes c
   WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id;

  v_destino := coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'destinatario_nome', e.destinatario_nome,
    'local_entrega', nullif(btrim(concat_ws(', ',
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_logradouro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_numero, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_bairro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_cidade, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_uf, '')), ''))), '')
  );

  -- OS canonica: fluxo padrao (ordens_servico) ou fluxo On-Farm legitimo.
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'os_id', o.id,
           'numero_os', o.numero_os,
           'origem', coalesce(o.origem, 'manual'),
           'tipo', 'ordem_servico'
         )
    INTO v_os
    FROM public.ordens_servico o
   WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id;

  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', onf.id,
             'numero_os', onf.numero_os,
             'origem', 'on_farm',
             'tipo', 'ordem_servico_onfarm'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm onf
     WHERE onf.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  END IF;

  -- Origem legitima adicional mapeada no dominio: entrega vinculada a pedido
  -- de parceiro (B2B) sem OS de laboratorio. Documentado em
  -- docs/auditorias/comprovante-entrega-fase2.md.
  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', po.id,
             'numero_os', po.numero,
             'origem', 'pedido_parceiro',
             'tipo', 'partner_order'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.partner_orders po
     WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id;
  END IF;

  -- Itens: caminho canonico por etiqueta
  SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item->>'lote')
    INTO v_itens
    FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
               'produto', coalesce(pe.produto_nome, pr.nome),
               'microrganismo', coalesce(array_to_string(pe.cepas, ', '), m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
               'lote', coalesce(pe.lote_codigo, l.codigo_lote),
               'fabricacao', coalesce(pe.fabricado_em::date, l.data_producao),
               'validade', pe.validade_em::date,
               'embalagem', coalesce(eb.tipo_embalagem, pe.unidade),
               'quantidade', coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1),
               'volume_unitario_ml', pe.volume,
               'volume_total_ml', coalesce(pe.volume, 0) * coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1)
             ) AS item
        FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
        JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = pe.produto_id
        LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = pe.lote_id
        LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
        LEFT JOIN public.estoque_embalagens eb ON eb.id = pe.embalagem_id
       WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ) s;

  -- Fallback: vinculo direto da entrega (fluxo classico produto_id/lote_id).
  -- Referencias sempre por e2 (linha atual), sem depender da variavel PL/pgSQL.
  IF v_itens IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(v_itens) = 0 THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
             'produto', pr.nome,
             'microrganismo', coalesce(m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
             'lote', l.codigo_lote,
             'fabricacao', l.data_producao,
             'validade', ep.validade,
             'embalagem', env.tipo_embalagem,
             'quantidade', e2.quantidade_entregue,
             'volume_unitario_ml', coalesce(
               env.volume_por_unidade,
               CASE WHEN coalesce(e2.quantidade_entregue, 0) > 0
                    THEN round(e2.volume_entregue_ml / e2.quantidade_entregue, 2) END),
             'volume_total_ml', coalesce(
               e2.volume_entregue_ml,
               env.volume_por_unidade * e2.quantidade_entregue)
           ))
      INTO v_itens
      FROM public.entregas e2
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr
             ON pr.id = coalesce(e2.produto_id,
                                 (SELECT l2.produto_id FROM public.lotes l2 WHERE l2.id = e2.lote_id))
      LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = e2.lote_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
      LEFT JOIN public.estoque_produto ep ON ep.id = e2.estoque_produto_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT en.tipo_embalagem, en.volume_por_unidade
          FROM public.envase en
         WHERE en.lote_id = e2.lote_id
         ORDER BY en.data_envase DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1
      ) env ON true
     WHERE e2.id = p_entrega_id;
  END IF;

  v_transporte := jsonb_build_object(
    'modalidade', e.tipo_entrega,
    'motorista', e.motorista,
    'motorista_telefone', e.motorista_telefone,
    'veiculo', e.veiculo,
    'placa', e.veiculo_placa,
    'veiculo_tipo', e.veiculo_tipo,
    'data_saida', e.data_saida,
    'hora_saida_prevista', e.hora_saida_prevista
  );

  v_receb := jsonb_build_object(
    'recebido_por_nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebido_por_nome, '')), ''),
                                  nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebedor_nome, '')), '')),
    'documento', coalesce(e.recebido_por_documento, e.recebedor_documento),
    'cargo', coalesce(e.recebido_por_cargo, e.recebedor_cargo),
    'observacoes', e.observacoes_confirmacao,
    'confirmado_em', coalesce(e.confirmada_em, e.entregue_em, e.recebimento_confirmado_em),
    'confirmado_por', coalesce(e.confirmado_por, e.confirmada_por, e.recebimento_confirmado_por),
    'assinatura_tipo', e.assinatura_tipo
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'comprovante-entrega-v1',
    'entrega_id', e.id,
    'entrega_status', e.status::text,
    'emitente', coalesce(v_emitente, '{}'::jsonb),
    'destinatario', coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb),
    'ordem_servico', v_os,
    'itens', coalesce(v_itens, '[]'::jsonb),
    'transporte', v_transporte,
    'recebimento', v_receb
  );
END
$function$
functions.name: fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_set_organization_status(_org uuid, _status text, _motivo text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_forbidden: apenas superadmin' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_financial_inconsistencies()
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, severity text, entity_type text, entity_id uuid, description text, recommended_action text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado' USING ERRCODE='insufficient_privilege';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  -- 1. Entrega BILLED sem receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_BILLED_NO_AR'::text, 'alta'::text, 'entregas'::text, e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como faturada sem título financeiro vinculado.'::text,
         'Reprocessar faturamento ou reverter status para PENDING_BILLING.'::text
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'BILLED' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 2. Entrega NOT_BILLABLE com receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_NOT_BILLABLE_WITH_AR', 'alta', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como sem cobrança porém possui título financeiro.',
         'Revisar status financeiro da entrega ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'NOT_BILLABLE' AND e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 3. Entrega com receivable_id apontando para AR inexistente
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega referencia um título que não existe mais.',
         'Limpar receivable_id ou recriar o título via faturamento.'
    FROM public.entregas e
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
   WHERE e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 4. AR sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AR_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Conta a receber sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
   WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ar.id
  HAVING count(ari.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 5. AP sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AP_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Conta a pagar sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_payable_installments api ON api.payable_id = ap.id
   WHERE ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ap.id
  HAVING count(api.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 6. AR PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AR_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 7. AP PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AP_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
   WHERE ap.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable_installments api
        WHERE api.payable_id = ap.id AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 8. Conta CANCELED com pagamento ativo (não estorno)
  SELECT 'AR_CANCELED_WITH_PAYMENT', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título cancelado possui baixas ativas não estornadas.',
         'Estornar pagamentos antes de manter o cancelamento.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'CANCELED'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.installment_id = ari.id
       WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND COALESCE(rp.is_reversal,false) = false
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments rp2 WHERE rp2.reversed_payment_id = rp.id)
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 9. Recibo emitido para pagamento de estorno
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_FOR_REVERSAL', 'alta', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo emitido sobre um lançamento de estorno.',
         'Cancelar o recibo.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND rp.is_reversal = true

  UNION ALL
  -- 10. Recibo emitido para pagamento inexistente
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_PAYMENT_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo aponta para pagamento inexistente.',
         'Cancelar o recibo ou restaurar o pagamento.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    LEFT JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND fr.payment_id IS NOT NULL AND rp.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 11. NF vinculada a AR inexistente
  SELECT 'FISCAL_INVOICE_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'fiscal_invoices', fi.id,
         'Nota fiscal vinculada a um título que não existe.',
         'Religar a NF a um título válido ou cancelá-la.'
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fi
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = fi.receivable_id
   WHERE fi.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 12. Documento financeiro órfão (owner_id sem registro)
  SELECT 'FINANCIAL_DOC_ORPHAN', 'media', 'financial_documents', fd.id,
         'Documento financeiro vinculado a um registro inexistente ('||fd.owner_type||').',
         'Excluir logicamente ou religar a entidade correta.'
    FROM public.financial_documents fd
   WHERE fd.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND (
       (fd.owner_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'PAYABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FISCAL_INVOICE' AND public.h15_invoice_access(fd.owner_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_RECEIVABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_PAYABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FINANCIAL_RECEIPT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_receipts WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 13. Entrega faturada duplicada (mesma entrega com >1 AR)
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_DUPLICATED_AR', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Mais de um título financeiro foi gerado para a mesma entrega.',
         'Cancelar os títulos extras.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.origin_type = 'DELIVERY'
     AND ar.origin_id IN (
       SELECT origin_id FROM public.accounts_receivable
        WHERE origin_type = 'DELIVERY' AND origin_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'
        GROUP BY origin_id HAVING count(*) > 1
     )

  ORDER BY 2, 1, 4;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_item_base(_components jsonb, _ctx jsonb)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v numeric := 0; c text;
BEGIN
  IF _components IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_components) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_INCOMPLETE: regra sem componentes de base declarados (base_components).'
      USING HINT = 'Declare explicitamente PRODUTO/FRETE/SEGURO/OUTRAS_DESPESAS/DESCONTO/IPI/ICMS_ST conforme base legal publicada.';
  END IF;
  FOR c IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(_components) LOOP
    v := v + CASE c
      WHEN 'PRODUTO'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'produto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'FRETE'            THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'frete')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'SEGURO'           THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'seguro')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'OUTRAS_DESPESAS'  THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'outras')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'DESCONTO'         THEN -coalesce((_ctx->>'desconto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'IPI'              THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'ipi')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'ICMS_ST'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'icmsSt')::numeric,0)
      ELSE 0 END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN public.fn_fiscal_round(v);
END $function$
